Scorch hurls a ball of oil that rolls in the target direction dealing 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to enemies hit. The oil will then remain for 5s, slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50%.
When ignited by Iggy's fire abilities, the duration is refreshed and enemies take 10/15/20/25/30 (+12% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s.
source_abilities.Q:
Iggy throws down a turret with 100 (+24 per Hero Level) (+10-32.5% magical power) Health that shoots homing fireballs at Enemy Targets within 1500 units. Each fireball deals 11/16/21/26/31 (+30% magical power) magical damage.
Iggy can have up to 3 turrets placed. Hitting an enemy with Spew redirects turrets to attack that target if in range. They also gain 40% Attack Speed if the Target is an Enemy Hero, or when Iggy casts Inferno.
Flame Turrets take 70% increased damage from Melee basic attacks.
source_abilities.R:
Scorch unleashes a cone of flame gaining 20/25/30% Movement Speed and dealing 375/600/825 (+260% magical power) magical damage over 3s.
At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Scorch will belch, instantly dealing 120/180/240 (+60% magical power) magical damage in the area and Knocking Back any Enemy Heroes present.
source_abilities.RMB:
Iggy flings a Molotov that deals 50/70/90/110/130 (+40% magical power) magical damage to enemies hit by the explosion.
A Fire Field will remain where the explosion occurs, dealing 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% magical power) magical damage over 2.5s.

ikra.reason: The projectile, control, charged bubble and ultimate explicitly deal magical damage. Eternal branches can alter utility; they do not make basic physical attacks the main caster threat.

source_abilities.E:
Ikra creates an Abyssal Bubble that Slows Enemies by 20% while they are in its radius.
The Bubble can be popped by hitting it with either Fathom or Brine, dealing 35/45/55/65/75 (+15% magical power) magical damage to all Targets in a 520 Unit radius and restoring 30 Mana.
The Bubble amplifies after 1.1s, increasing the damage dealt to 75/120/165/210/255 (+80% magical power) magical damage whilst Slowing all Targets hit by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1s.
Popping a Bubble with Brine deals Brine's Damage as well as Hydroclasm's Damage. If the Bubble is amplified when popped by Brine, the total damage penetrates 40% of the Target's Magical Armor.
Max Charges: 2
source_abilities.Q:
Ikra unleashes a Water Sphere dealing 85/115/145/175/205 (+50% magical power) magical damage.
The Sphere pierces through Enemy Units but stops on hitting an Enemy Hero, surrounding and Suspending them for 1.1s.
source_abilities.R:
Ikra rises into the sky for 1s and channels the tides before unleashing a surging Waterspout from his Trident that pierces Walls.
The Waterspout deals 320/480/640 (+85% magical power) magical damage and Knocks Up Enemies hit.
When Enemy Targets land from the Knock Up, they are Slowed by 50% for 1.25s.
source_abilities.RMB:
Ikra fires a quick Hydroblast dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+45% magical power) magical damage to the first Enemy Target hit or popping the first Bubble it impacts. 
Whenever Brine kills an Enemy, Ikra gains 3/4/5/6/7 additional Gold. Killing Enemies by Popping Bubbles with Brine also grants this Gold.

kallari.reason: Dagger, movement strike and ultimate deliver physical damage, with a separate true-damage mark. Camouflage changes access, not the physical damage type.

source_abilities.E:
Kallari backflips into the sky. After a short duration, she may target an Enemy to dash towards them, dealing 35/55/75/95/115 (+45% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals 2x damage if the Target is affected by Death Mark.
source_abilities.R:
After a brief delay Kallari dashes forward, cutting through all Enemies in her path, dealing 120/250/380 (+65/75/85% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals up to 2.5x damage based on the Target's missing health.
source_abilities.RMB:
Throw a dagger, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 (+85% physical power) physical damage and applying a 25% Slow for 0.75s.
Minions and Monsters receive 130 additional damage. 
Max Charges: 2.

khaimera.reason: The attack window, leap and ultimate deliver physical damage. Regeneration and health scaling do not imply magical damage.

source_abilities.Q:
Unleash Khaimera's primal spirit for 3s, granting him maximum attack speed for 5 successful attacks.
Khaimera gains an additional attack for every 30 Magical Power owned. 
Each basic attack deals (+54/58/62/66/70% physical power)(+12% magical power) physical damage, applies on-hit effects at 65% effectiveness and Cleaves nearby Enemies for 75% damage.
source_abilities.R:
After a brief channel, Khaimera slices all Enemies in front of him, Stunning them for 1.25s and dealing 200/400/600 (+200% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage over 6 hits. The final hit Slows by 25% for 1.25s.
Grants 20 Rage stacks for each Enemy Hero or Monster hit.
source_abilities.RMB:
Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70% physical power) physical damage and Slowing them by 25/30/35/40/45% for 1.35s. Deals up to 2x damage based on the Target's missing health. 
Grants 15 Rage on hit.

kira.reason: Attacks, Vengeance conversion and the ultimate form a physical damage pattern. Purchased magic procs are additional, not established by the pick alone.

source_abilities.Passive:
Nevermore activates every 15/14.5/14/13.5/13/12.5/12/11.5/11/10.5/10/9.5/9/8.5/8/7.5/7/6.5s (-0.5 per Level), empowering Kira.
While empowered, Kira's next Basic Attack or Mercy blast fires a Raven at the target that explodes on impact, dealing (+7% of the Target's Current Health) physical damage to all targets in a small area.
source_abilities.Q:
Passive: Apply Vengeance to enemies by dealing basic attack or ability damage, increasing damage you deal to them by 0.75% for 3.5s, stacking infinitely.
Active: Purify all Enemy Units afflicted with Vengeance, dealing 45/65/85/105/125 physical damage, plus an additional 6/8/10/12/14 (+12% physical power) damage per stack, and Slowing them by 10/15/20/25/30% for 1s.
The cooldown is reset if Dusk kills any target.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460% physical power) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s.
These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike.
While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.
source_abilities.RMB:
Equip Mercy to fire a powerful shot dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+74/78/82/86/90% physical power) physical damage and applying 3 stacks of Vengeance to the Target.
Mercy benefits from Lifesteal, can Critically Strike, and applies on-hit effects.

kwang.reason: The shield strike, thrown blade, ultimate and energized effect supply magical damage, with a conditional true-damage strike. Physical basic attacks alone do not justify physical-only defense.

source_abilities.Passive:
When Kwang damages an Enemy with an ability his Heavenly Blade becomes Energized with electricity for 4s, stacking up to 3 times.
Whilst Energized, Kwang gains 45% attack speed and his next basic attack strikes lightning from above dealing 10/12/14/16/18/21/24/27/30/33/37/41/45/49/53/57/62/67 (+4 per level)(+20% magical power) magical damage to the Target and nearby Enemies. 
If this damages an Enemy Hero, Kwang reduces his basic ability cooldowns by 0.5s per stack.
source_abilities.Q:
Throw the Heavenly Blade at a target location to deal 90/115/140/165/190 (+40% magical power) magical damage.
Enemies hit by the Blade will be Tethered to it for 1.3s. 
When in the world, the Blade grants vision in a small area around it.
Recalling the Blade early will break the Tether.
source_abilities.R:
Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade, dealing 230/340/450 (+80% magical power) magical damage and applying a 45/55/65% Slow for 2s to nearby Enemy Units. 
If the Blade is in the world, Kwang will Teleport to it before striking.
source_abilities.RMB:
Light strikes the Heavenly Blade, dealing damage to nearby Enemy Units. 
While holding the Blade, it deals 75/110/145/180/215 (+60% magical power)(+70% physical power) magical damage and grants Kwang a 65/95/125/155/185 (+40% magical power) (+9% health) Shield for 2.5s. 
If the Blade is in the world, it deals 90/125/160/195/230 (+80% magical power)(+80% physical power) true damage instead.

legion.reason: Rifle, explosives and orbital beam explicitly deal physical damage. Physical penetration and attack-speed conversion support this pattern, not a conventional attack-speed carry assumption.

source_abilities.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 20/21.16/22.37/23.65/24.99/26.39/27.86/29.38/30.97/32.62/34.33/36.11/37.94/39.84/41.8/43.82/45.91/48.05 (+17% physical power) Physical Damage. This damage is increased by +1.35% per 1 Physical Penetration owned.
If Legion does not fire for 1.25 seconds, the rifle's ammo will gradually replenish.
When the magazine is empty, Legion reloads his rifle.
source_abilities.Q:
Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world, Enemies or by reactivation. 
Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Slows Enemies hit by 40% for 1s. 
Consecutive Mine hits on the same Enemy deal 25% Damage.
source_abilities.R:
Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, an Orbital Beam blasts the designated location, tracking Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes.
Enemy Targets within the blast take 30/50/70 (+26% physical power) (+10% magical power) Physical Damage every 0.25s. The Orbital Beam persists for 6/7.5/9s.
If there are no Enemy Targets within 2000 units, the blast remains stationary.
source_abilities.RMB:
Legion cooks a Grenade with a 2.2s fuse, reducing the time before detonation based on duration held. 
Throw the Grenade causing an explosion that deals 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Launches Legion or Enemies hit. The Grenade automatically explodes after 0.2s if it is near an Enemy.
When cooked for the full duration, it will explode in Legion's hand.
If Legion is Stunned, Killed or cancels the ability whilst cooking the Grenade, it drops to the floor.

lt-belica.reason: Bomb, knock-up, drone and ultimate deliver magical damage. Her attack augment is a separate plan; physical basic attacks are not the main caster output.

source_abilities.E:
Deploy a drone for 12s that grants vision in the area and drains 2/2.75/3.5/4.25/5% of nearby Enemy Heroes' Current Mana each second. 
The drone zaps nearby Heroes if they cast an ability, or if Lt. Belica damages them with an ability, dealing 60/70/80/90/100 (+20% magical power) magical damage and draining 2.5% of the Target's Maximum Mana. 
Innovation: Zap Max Mana drain increases to 6%.
source_abilities.Q:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/145/190/235/280 (+60% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s. 
Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.
The hitbox width is 270u. This ability can be Blink-proxied during the cast.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a heavy blast from Lt. Belica's sidearm, dealing 200/325/450 (+65% magical power) magical damage and silencing them for 0.5s. Damage increases by 25/30/35% of the Target's Missing Mana. 
For Manaless Heroes, the damage increases by 20/25/30% of the Target's Missing Health. 
Innovation: Resets Cooldown upon killing an Enemy Hero with the blast.
source_abilities.RMB:
Place a bomb that detonates after a short delay, dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+70% magical power) magical damage. Restores 6/7/8/9/10 Mana for each Enemy hit. 
Innovation: Detonate a second time after a short delay, dealing 80 (+30% magical power) magical damage.

maco.reason: The damaging spells are magical. Healing and utility on support income should not satisfy the composition’s need for a dedicated magic damage plan.

source_abilities.E:
Maco leaps high into the air before slamming back down to the ground with his gemstone, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70% magical power) magical damage to Enemies and Slowing them by 30% (+5% magical power) for 1.5s.
If Maco hits an Enemy Hero, he gains a 60/115/170/225/280 (+50% magical power) (+4% health) Shield for 3.5s.
After landing, Maco dashes slightly in the direction he is currently moving.
source_abilities.R:
Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels.
When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 70/110/150 (+35% magical power) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it.
At the gemstone's max range, it explodes, dealing 100/160/220 (+50% magical power) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 0.25-1.4s, based on charge time.
source_abilities.RMB:
Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability.
When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s.
Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s, based on the distance it travels.

morigesh.reason: Mark, Hive, Swarm and Curse deliver magical damage. Short range and access are weaknesses, not different damage types.

source_abilities.E:
Become the swarm, gaining 50% decaying Movement Speed and 12% (+1.5% magical power) Damage Reduction for 3.5s. Passing through Enemy Units deals 110/150/190/230/270 (+75% magical power) magical damage and restores health equal to 30% of the pre-mitigated damage dealt. Healing is reduced by 75% against Minions. 
Swarm's effect is fully refreshed if it damages an Enemy Hero, and its duration is extended by 0.5s when colliding with Non-Heroes. Morigesh also gains an additional 25% Decaying Movement Speed over 1s when colliding with Non-Heroes.
source_abilities.Q: Throw a hive of insects that explodes dealing 100/140/180/220/260 (+65% magical power) magical damage and Slowing targets hit by 50%, decaying over 3s.
source_abilities.R:
After a brief channel, Summon a horde of insects to stab the Marked target, dealing 300/430/560 (+80% magical power) magical damage.
The Mark is removed upon casting this ability.
source_abilities.RMB:
Select an Enemy Target to deal 60/80/100/120/140 (+45% magical power) magical damage and, if they are a Hero, Mark them.
Damaging Enemy Targets with Mark absorbs part of their soul restoring 8/18/28/38/48 (+20% magical power) Health, increasing by 15% against Heroes for each stack of Pestilence they possess.
Killing an Enemy Unit with Mark refunds 50% of its cooldown, and 65% of the Mana spent.

mourn.reason: Abduct and Extract establish magical damage within a utility kit. Do not treat the physical basic attack as a farmed physical carry.

source_abilities.Passive: Mourn's next basic attack will deal an additional 20/28/36/44/52/60/68/76/84/92/100/108/116/124/132/140/148/156 (+50% magical power)(+90% physical power)(+6% health) magical damage to all targets hit. Damaging an Enemy Target will restore (3%/5%/7%/9% Maximum Health) Health.
source_abilities.RMB:
Channel for up to 3s, Slowing yourself by 25% and wind up your vines, increasing their range over 1s. After 3s the ability will be cancelled and go on a 50% cooldown.
Confirm to unleash the vines that will collide with the first enemy target hit dealing 80/125/170/215/260 (+85% magical power) magical damage, Pulling them towards Mourn and Slowing them by 90% for 0.75s.

murdock.reason: Basic attacks, Buckshot and the sniper ultimate form the physical attack plan. Static Trap’s magical damage is a secondary control component.

source_abilities.R:
Murdock kneels, preparing an energized sniper shot with unlimited range that can travel through anything.
While targeting, using the Alternate Ability input will zoom the scope inwards.
Upon firing, it deals 250/400/550 (+115% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in its path, ignoring any physical armor.
source_abilities.RMB:
Discharge a Terrain piercing shotgun blast, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+100/120/140/160/180% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies hit, decreasing by up to 50% based on distance and Shredding their physical armor by 15% for 4s.
The blast Pushes Enemies Back, its force increasing at close range.

muriel.reason: Serenity supplies magical damage, but the kit’s main team contribution is protection and amplification. Support coverage still needs a dedicated damage dealer.

source_abilities.RMB:
Charge a piercing bolt of energy for up to 4s that deals 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slows by 35% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. 
If Muriel charges Serenity for 1.1s it reaches max charge and deals 98/147/196/245/294 (+70% magical power) magical damage and Stuns the target for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s instead.
If Muriel cancels the charge, 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the cost is refunded.
Projectile radius: 85. Projectile speed: 3900 (official patch-note values).

narbash.reason: Thunk and the damaging ultimate supply magic within a healing/control kit. Basic physical attacks do not establish a primary physical carry.

source_abilities.R:
Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5/7.5/10 (+4% magical power)(+7% physical power) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. 
Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead.
The final hit deals 80/150/220 (+80% magical power)(+120% physical power) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.
source_abilities.RMB: Toss a drumstick that deals 95/140/185/230/275 (+85% magical power)(+130% physical power) magical damage in a tiny area of effect, Knocking Back and Stunning the Enemies hit for 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s.

neon.reason: The spell sequence is magical with separately described true-damage components. Magical penetration affects the magical portion, not true damage.

source_abilities.E:
Neon lobs a projectile. After 0.5s of landing or colliding with an enemy target, it detonates, dealing 85/120/155/190/225 (+60% magical power) Magical Damage and slowing targets by 35% for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4s.
Overclocked: Targets are Mesmerized as well as Slowed.
source_abilities.Q:
Neon sends out a Data Construct, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5% magical power) Magical Damage to enemies it passes through. The Data Construct then returns to Neon, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5% magical power) True Damage on its way back.
Overclocked: Before returning, the Data Construct emits a pulse at its maximum range, dealing 48/69/90/111/132 (+42.5% magical power) True Damage.
source_abilities.R:
Neon Overclocks her systems for 8s, gaining 15/20/25% Movement Speed, 45% Jump Height, and causing all her Basic Abilities to be Overclocked for the duration.
Recast: During System Overdrive, Neon can recast this ability to jump upwards and launch an explosive bomb, dealing 155/225/295 (+55/60/65% magical power) magical damage, increased by up to 90% based on the target's missing health.
source_abilities.RMB:
Dash in the current movement direction, Empowering your next Jolt within 3s to explode, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+40% magical power) bonus Magical Damage to the target and nearby enemies as well as Slowing them by 20% for 0.5s.
Overclocked: Can be Recast once within 3s at no cost.

phase.reason: Flare and Lance deal magical damage while the link enables an ally. A support build is an enabler rather than a replacement magic carry.

source_abilities.E:
Channel a beam of energy dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+90% magical power) magical damage over 2.5s. Each instance of damage applies a stacking 3% Slow that lasts 0.6s.
Upon reaching 8 stacks the target is Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
source_abilities.Q:
Blast a flare of psychic energy around Phase and her Linked Ally, dealing 75/110/145/180/215 (+80% magical power) magical damage and Blinding Enemies that are facing it for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. 
Enemies take 40% damage from a second flare.
Damaging an Enemy Hero with Psychic Flare reduces Phase's Blink Cooldown to 2.5s.

rampage.reason: Attacks, Pounce and Rumble form the physical brawling pattern; the boulder adds magical catch damage. A tank build does not automatically replace a dedicated physical damage plan.

source_abilities.E:
Pound the ground with each fist, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 (+50% physical power) physical damage over 2 hits to nearby Enemies and Slowing them by 30% (+0.4% health) for 1s.
Passive: Gain (+1.5/1.8/2.1/2.4/2.7% health) Physical Power.
Behemoth: Cooldown is reduced by 35%.
source_abilities.RMB:
Leap forward before slamming down to the ground, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+5% health) physical damage to nearby Enemies and launching damaged Heroes backwards. The leap can be cancelled early by basic attacking.
Using Pounce while Boulder Throw is active causes it to shatter upon landing, dealing its effects in the area.
Behemoth: Range increases by 65%.

renna.reason: Soulfire and the damaging spells form a magical caster plan. Essence, sustain and defense support repeated casts without changing the damage type.

source_abilities.E:
Renna shifts upwards and prepares to launch a ball of demonic energy.
Upon re-activating or after 1.5s, Renna will launch the orb that explodes on contact dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+50% magical power) damage and mesmerizing Targets hit for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
Deals an additional 1% of the Target's Current Health as Magical Damage per 30 Essence.
source_abilities.Q:
Launch a Soul Orb that deploys upon contact with a Hero or the World. Once deployed, the Soul Orb attacks nearby Enemy Targets, pulling them in and dealing 70/100/130/160/190 (+50% magical power) magical damage over 4s. Enemies that take damage from Soul Orb while below 6% (+1% per 30 Essence) health are executed.
Renna is healed for 16/18/20/22/24% of her damage dealt to Targets attached to the Soul Orb. Healing is 8% effective against Minions and Monsters.
The radius is increased by 1% per 10 Essence.
source_abilities.R:
After a 1.5s channel, Renna teleports to the Target location and summons an infernal singularity above herself for 5s that unleashes projectiles every 0.5s at nearby Targets that deal 60/78/96 (+24% magical power) magical damage.
Lasts 0.5s longer per 50 Essence.
source_abilities.RMB:
Swing your weapon to fire 3 piercing projectile waves over 1.5s that each deal 50/57/64/71/78 (+21% magical power) damage.
Swings faster to create an additional projectile within the same duration per 50 Essence.

revenant.reason: The firing cycle, fourth shot and damaging spells establish physical burst. The isolation ultimate changes who can participate, not the damage type.

source_abilities.E:
Launch a cursed orb that deals 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and apply 4 stacks of Marked for 6s.
Dealing damage to a Marked Target deals 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and consumes a stack.
Upon consuming all stacks, the Target is Rooted for 1s.
source_abilities.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 53/55.38/57.89/60.52/63.29/66.18/69.19/72.34/75.61/79.01/82.54/86.19/89.98/93.89/97.92/102.09/106.38/110.8 (+85% physical power) physical damage.
The final round will always critically strike.
After four basic attacks, Revenant will automatically reload.
source_abilities.Q:
Unleash 10 ethereal missiles within a wide cone that home towards random Enemies. If a Target is Marked by Scar, the missiles prioritize them instead. 
Each missile deals 35/50/65/80/95 (+40/55/70/85/100% physical power) (+60/65/70/75/80% magical power) physical damage. 
Enemy Heroes and Monsters take 10% damage from missiles beyond the first.
source_abilities.RMB:
Passive: Critical Damage is modified to 150/152/154/156/158/160%.
Hand Cannon's final round deals bonus physical damage equal to 5/6/7/8/9/10% (+0.5% per Level) (+0.02% magical power) of the Target's missing health and removes Revenant's combat penalty if it hits, granting him 12% (+18% attack speed) Movement Speed for 2s.
Active: Revenant reloads his Hand Cannon.

riktor.reason: Hook, silence, aura and ultimate deliver magical damage on a control tank. Incidental physical attacks do not supply a dedicated physical plan.

source_abilities.E:
Emit an electrical aura for 4.5s, granting Riktor a 20 (+8/9.5/11/12.5/14% health) (+35% magical power) Shield and 8/9/10/11/12% Movement Speed for the duration. 
The electrical aura deals 60/95/130/165/200 (+6% health) (+35% magical power) magical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration.
If Riktor takes damage while the aura is active, he emits a pulse of energy that deals another tick of damage at 75% effectiveness. This can only occur once every 0.5s.
source_abilities.Q: Swing an electrified whip that destroys enemy shields before dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+70% physical power)(+60% magical power) magical damage and Silencing them for 0.8s.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a torrent of chains from Riktor, dealing 110/200/290 (+45% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Suppressing them for 1.3s. 
After the Supression expires Riktor rips the chains out, repeating the damage.
source_abilities.RMB: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.

scarlett.reason: The sword, stabs, movement and ultimate deliver physical damage. Her shield and disputed resource details do not establish a magical conversion.

source_abilities.E:
Scarlett dashes forward with a decisive, fiery strike that deals 65/85/105/125/145 (+80% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in her path and receives a 30/80/130/180/230 (+40/45/50/55/60% physical power) Shield for 3s.
Each time Scarlett hits an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader with First Intent she refreshes her Shield's duration and increases its size by 60%, and restores 50 Energy.
source_abilities.LMB:
Melee basic attack chain dealing 61/63.24/65.6/68.08/70.68/73.4/76.24/79.2/82.28/85.48/88.8/92.24/95.8/99.48/103.28/107.2/111.24/115.4 (+80% physical power) physical damage.
Chain Attack Rate: 2x/2x/1.05x.
Chain Damage: 0.5x/0.5x/1.1x.
Third Strike: Restores 5 Energy On-Hit. Increased to 10/10/15/20 at Levels 1/6/11/16 against Heroes.
Empowered: Equip your Lantern for 1 attack, slamming it forward in a line.
source_abilities.Q:
Scarlett channels for a short duration, before swinging her Lantern around her, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 (+60% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area.
Outer Edge hits deal 25/50/75/100/125 (+100% physical power) additional damage and Slow targets hit by 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% for 1.25s. 
Outer Edge hits on Enemy Heroes or Camp Leaders Empower Scarlett's next Cindara attack for 4s, causing it to now damage all Enemies in a line in front of her, dealing 15 (+12% physical power) (+3/3.5/4/4.5/5% Target's Max Health) bonus damage, and restoring 35/45/55 Energy upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader.
Empowered Cindara damage is reduced by 50% against Minions and is capped against Monsters.
Ablaze: Empowered Cindara's bonus damage is increased by 1.5x.
source_abilities.R:
Scarlett strikes forward with her lantern, with its chain Restraining the first Enemy Hero hit for 1.4s, and Slowing nearby Enemies by 65% for 1s.
Scarlett then backflips into the air, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the Restrain, and ignites her Blade before striking down at her target, dealing 180/280/350 (+100% physical power) physical damage. 
Enemies near the Restrained Hero also receive 100% of the strike's damage.
After striking, Scarlett's Blade remains Ablaze for 8/10/12s, granting her +150 Basic Attack Range, 5 Energy Regen, 20/32/44 (+12% physical power) Physical Power, and enhancing certain abilities for the duration.
Range is 960u.
source_abilities.RMB:
Scarlett twirls in her current movement direction, with its speed increasing based on current momentum. 
Scarlett then stabs forward 3 times, with each dealing 21/31/41/51/61 (+24/28.5/33/37.5/42% physical power) physical damage. The final stab deals up to 125% bonus damage based on the Target's Missing Health.
Stabs benefit from Lifesteal and can Critically Strike at 60% effectiveness. 
Ablaze: Number of Stabs is increased to 4, dealing 15% more damage overall.

serath.reason: Attacks and the main strike/dive pattern supply physical pressure, while Chastise adds magical damage and the ultimate supplies true on-hit damage. No equal damage split is assumed.

source_abilities.E:
Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage.
Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s
source_abilities.LMB:
Melee basic attack dealing 55/56.82/58.74/60.75/62.86/65.07/67.38/69.79/72.29/74.89/77.59/80.38/83.28/86.26/89.35/92.54/95.82/99.2 (+70% physical power) physical damage.
Additionally deals (+15% physical power) magical damage on-hit.
source_abilities.Q:
Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% physical power) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters.
On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position.
If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
source_abilities.R:
Serath takes demonic form, dealing 60/90/120 (+50% physical power)(+80% magical power) physical damage to nearby Enemies and setting them ablaze.
For the next 7s, she gains 20/25/30% movement speed, 20/40/60% attack speed, and empowers her basic attack with Infernal Strikes. 
Infernal Strikes sets Enemy Units ablaze on-hit, dealing 14/27/40 (+25% physical power)(+20% magical power) true damage on-hit over 2s.

sevarog.reason: Siphon, movement fear, chain zone and knockback deal magical damage. Health scaling and a physical basic attack do not make the spell package physical.

source_abilities.E:
Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing 60/75/90/105/120 (+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Slowing them by 30% and Chaining them to the center for 2s.
If a Chained target leaves the zone, they take 75/90/105/120/135 (+60% magical power) magical damage and are Stunned for 1.25s.
source_abilities.Q:
Strike forward with a spectral hand, dealing 80/95/110/125/140 (+4% health)(+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies. 
Deals 30/35/40/45/50 additional damage to Monsters.
If Siphon damages an Enemy Hero, Sevarog steals 1.8/2/2.2/2.4/2.6% of their Maximum Health for 15s.
source_abilities.R:
Deliver a heavy blow from Sevarog's hammer, dealing 200/330/460 (+75% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him.
Enemy Heroes struck by the blow are Knocked Back, sending them flying.
At maximum rank, Colossal Blow Executes Minions.
source_abilities.RMB: Sevarog dashes forward through the air, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 (+2.5% health) magical damage to all Enemies he passes through and Fearing them for 1s.

shinbi.reason: Dashes, wolves and the ultimate form a magical cast/attack pattern. Her energized attacks add magic; repeated attacks alone do not establish physical-only damage.

source_abilities.E:
After a short delay, summon 4 Spirit Wolves that circle Shinbi for 2.4s, granting 20% decaying movement speed and a 45/65/85/105/125 (+35% magical power) shield for the same duration and after the wolves expire.
The wolves deal 30/42/54/66/78 (+22% magical power) magical damage per hit, up to 3 times.
source_abilities.Passive:
Shinbi's Basic Attacks deal an additional 12 (+10% physical power)(+10% magical power) magical damage on-hit. 
Every 10s (-0.4s per Level), Shinbi's next Basic Attack applies Biting Melody for 2.5x damage, applying Track to the target, and restoring 20/26/32/38/44/50/56/62/68/74/80/86/92/98/104/110/116/122 (+6 per Level) Mana.
source_abilities.Q:
Summon a Spirit Wolf that runs in a straight line towards your reticule and passes through all Enemy Targets dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+55% magical power) magical damage.
After hitting a target, deals 60% damage to subsequent Minions.
source_abilities.R:
Passive: Shinbi applies a Mark to Enemy Heroes that she damages with her abilities, lasting for 6s. Additionally, each time Shinbi damages a Hero with an ability she gains a stack of Track for 6s, stacking up to 8 times. 
Upon reaching maximum Track stacks, Shinbi can activate this ability.
Active: Shinbi summons a pack of 8 Spirit Wolves above each currently Marked Enemy Hero. The pack attacks their target, dealing 44/68/92 (+16% magical power) magical damage per Spirit Wolf.
source_abilities.RMB:
Shinbi dashes forward through the air, dealing 50/85/120/155/190 (+55% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies she passes through. 
Max Charges: 2

skylar.reason: The attack, beam, grenade and ultimate package delivers physical damage. Flight affects access and vulnerability, not damage type.

source_abilities.Q:
Launch a bouncing nano bubble that attaches to the first target hit for 0.75s and deals 20/30/40/50/60 (+20% physical power) physical damage.
After the duration, the target and nearby enemies take 70/100/130/160/190 (+145% physical power)(+80% magical power) physical damage and are Slowed by 40/45/50/55/60% for 1s.
source_abilities.R: Channel for a short period of time before firing a large orb of unstable energy. The orb stops on the first hero hit, exploding, dealing 200/330/460 (+150% physical power)(+90% magical power)(+20/25/30% of target’s missing health) physical damage.
source_abilities.RMB:
Skylar hypercharges Starfire for 5s (refreshes on Hero Takedown):
Convert bonus attack speed into on-hit physical damage and attack at a fixed rate of 10 attacks per second while also ignoring 20% of your Target's Bonus Physical Armor. Starfire's damage is modified to 1/2.5/4/5.5/7 (+10% physical power)(+4% magical power)(+10% attack speed) per instance and it applies on-hit effects at 10% effectiveness. Damaging Enemy Units with Hypercharge increases its damage by 1% for 1s, stacking up to 25 times.
Passive: Basic Attacks deal 4/8/12/16/20 (+10% physical power) bonus physical damage on-hit.

sparrow.reason: Repeated attacks and the extended firing ultimate form a physical damage plan. Purchased on-hit effects can add damage types but are not known from a hero pick.

source_abilities.E:
Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15% magical power) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s.
Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15% physical power) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
source_abilities.Passive:
Sparrow's Basic Attacks and Abilities apply stacks of Relentless to Enemy Units. 
Her Basic Attacks against Targets afflicted by Relentless deal an additional 0.25% of their maximum health as bonus physical damage On-Hit, per stack.
Relentless stacks last for 3s, stacking up to 8 times.
source_abilities.Q:
Release a volley of arrows that rain down over 2.5s, dealing 100/130/160/190/220 (+100% physical power)(+80% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area over 8 hits.
Enemies struck by Hail Of Arrows are Slowed by 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% (+5% magical power) for 0.5s.
source_abilities.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

steel.reason: The control abilities deal magical damage; Heavy Metal can add magical on-hit damage. A tank’s physical basic attack is not a primary physical damage source.

source_abilities.Q:
Steel charges forward, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the dash and dealing 85/125/165/205/245 (+5% health)(+70% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in his path. 
Enemy Heroes struck by Bull Rush are Knocked Back. Monsters and Minions are Stunned for 2s.
source_abilities.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.
source_abilities.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.

terra.reason: The armor-scaling charge and attacks deal physical damage. Armor is a scaling attribute, not evidence of magical damage.

source_abilities.E:
Throw a spectral axe, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+30% physical armor)(+30% magical armor) physical damage to all Enemies in its path.
Enemies hit by Highland Hurl are Slowed by 40% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. and have their Physical Armor reduced by 20% for 4.5s.
Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
source_abilities.Q:
Terra spins her axe, striking all Enemies around her before slashing forward a second time. Each strike deals 50/80/110/140/170 (+35% physical armor)(+35% magical armor) physical damage.
Enemy Hero hits refund 10% of the cooldown per strike.
Empowered: Terra strikes three times, with the third strike dealing an additional (+5/6.25/7.5/8.75/10 Target's Max Health)% damage to all Enemies in front of her.
source_abilities.RMB:
Terra becomes Unstoppable and Channels for up to 3.5s before dashing. She deals 27/48/69/90/111 (+40% bonus physical armor) (+40% bonus magical armor) physical damage to all Enemies in her path, stopping if she collides with a Hero. Enemies hit are Knocked Back for 0.25s.
For the first 1.25s, dash range and damage increases, dealing up to 81/144/207/270/333 (+120% bonus physical armor) (+120% bonus magical armor) physical damage. 
Empowered: On Enemy hit, gain a 5/65/125/185/245 (+10/12/14/16/18% health) shield for 3.5s.

the-fey.reason: Growth, patch, nettles and trap deliver magical spell damage. Support and midlane budgets still have different damage jobs.

source_abilities.E:
Throw an orb of energy, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+55% magical power) magical damage. Hitting the same Target within 8s deals 20% increased damage, stacking up to 4 times.
Harvest Nettles refunds 75% of its mana cost upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Killing a Unit.
source_abilities.Q:
Summon a patch of thorny brambles, dealing 90/130/170/210/250 (+70% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies that touch them and Slowing them by 35% for 0.5s. Allies within the brambles gain 15% movement speed for 0.5s.
Bramble Patch persists for 5s before wilting.

wukong.reason: The stance attacks and clone ultimate form physical pressure. Unverified item duplication on clones is excluded from this assessment.

Body:

meta_review.method: Authored judgments from current role observations, named kit interactions, role economy and current official changes. Grades are not calculated win probabilities, source-provided tiers, or proven optimal picks. A 3 percentage-point change from the review sample with at least 500 current games flags the grade for review; that trigger is not a significance test. Samples below 500 receive a limited-sample note. Refreshing data does not rewrite this review.
meta_review.scope: General ranked planning with composition-specific conditions; Gold+ evidence. No claim of a professional-play or all-rank consensus.

tier_definitions.A: Strong alternative with a clear role or enabling condition.
tier_definitions.B: Situational or practiced pick; check what the team needs.
tier_definitions.C: Lower default priority in this review; favor comfort or a favorable matchup.
tier_definitions.S: Priority starting point for its stated job; still depends on draft and execution.

guidance.note: Written guidance is editorial judgment, not a statistical ranking. A data refresh does not author new strategic advice.
notes: Jungle: Zarus is the containment default; Aurora provides layered magical control; Serath is the second-wave damage pick. Steel is the direct tank option with a smaller current sample. Rampage remains a durable alternative rather than disappearing after nerfs.

Mid: Lt. Belica offers direct catch with stronger current role evidence; Gideon earns a coordination premium when the team protects his channel. The Fey fits prepared area control. Howitzer remains a credible alternative; the old broad-dataset demotion is not carried forward.

Carry: Drongo supplies silence and physical shred, Sparrow needs protected attack time, Legion supplies physical area pressure, and Eden rewards practiced stance management. Skylar and Revenant remain usable, but the old automatic carry pool does not override current role evidence.

Support: choose Steel for a direct opening, Mourn for catch plus sustain, Muriel for amplification/protection when initiation already exists, or Narbash for a grouped fight. Riktor is a hook-execution option rather than an automatic upgrade to every composition.

Offlane: Greystone is the established pressure default. Akeron supplies sustain and frontlining; Grux punishes reachable melee fights; Shinbi supplies magical skirmishing. Iggy is a strong lane-pressure alternative only when another role supplies frontline. Terra and Serath offlane do not inherit their old recommendations or another role’s grade.

Counter lists describe observed games with the named hero present, not proof of a lane or ability interaction. Use the reviewed counterplay to decide which response you can execute, then inspect the individual sample without adding overlapping rows.

Community builds are alternative hypotheses. Their item sequences were compared with current item triggers and your role plan; popularity or a high conditional build rate cannot establish that a purchase caused the wins.
guidance.pools_note: Ordered working pools for Gold+ planning. Choose the job first: direct catch, secondary dive, sustained damage or protection. These are reviewed preferences, not measured ordered ranks. Specialist and lower-priority heroes remain selectable.

abilities.ability_text:
Adele unfurls her Sword in a straight line, dealing 40/55/70/85/100 (+80% physical power) true damage to all Enemies it passes through.
If she hits an Enemy Hero or Monster, they are Rooted for 0.6s and Adele dashes to the furthest target hit.
abilities.note: The root lasts 0.6s and Adele travels to the furthest hero or monster hit. Aim the line so that arrival remains useful to the ally.

abilities.ability_text:
Adele swings her sword, gaining 40% Movement Speed for the duration.. She deals 5/20/35/50/65 (+50/60/70/80/90% physical power) physical damage twice to nearby Enemies and Mesmerizes them for 1s. Mesmerized Enemies are immune to Slows.
Adele then slams her sword down in an area to deal 60/80/100/120/140 (+8% health) true damage to all Enemies hit.
abilities.note: The mesmerize occurs during the sword sequence. The selected Tyrant of Thorns removes it, so that loadout cannot supply this control.

abilities.ability_text:
Adele performs a small leap, slamming her shield into the ground, summoning a large Thornbush at her location for 8s. 
Vines attach to all Enemies within the central section, dealing 55/90/125 (+5% health) physical damage. This Interrupts abilities, Roots Enemies for 0.5s, and pulls flying Enemies to the ground.
All Enemies inside the Thornbush are Slowed by 35/37.5/40% and take 4/7/10 true damage every 35u moved within it.
abilities.note: The initial root is only 0.5s. The eight-second thornbush slows and punishes movement; it does not hold enemies motionless for eight seconds.

abilities.ability_text:
Akeron fires a web, stopping on the first Target hit and causing various effects depending on the Target's type.
Heroes or Units: Damages for 70/95/120/145/170 (+35% magical power) magical damage and Roots for 1s, also creating a web field that Slows Enemies by 35%.
World: Lashes to it for up to 5s. While attached to terrain, Akeron can use abilities or leap to the ground, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+50% physical power)(+35% magical power) physical damage, Knocking Up, and Stunning Enemies for 1s.
Awakened: Root and Stun Duration increased to 1.25.
abilities.note: A direct hit roots a target; a terrain attachment needs a separate leap to deliver the knock-up. Specify which branch starts the fight.

abilities.ability_text:
Akeron Slows himself by 35% while Pulling and dealing 15/20/25 (+5% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in a cone every 0.25s for 3s.
If an Enemy Hero collides with Akeron, he bites them, dealing 55/75/95 (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage while healing for 2.5/3.5/4.5% Missing Health + 40/50/60% of bite damage dealt.
Akeron Executes Enemies bitten under 12% (+3.5% physical power)(+2.5% magical power) of their Max Health.
Each time Akeron successfully executes a Hero, he gains 100/125/150 Maximum Health permanently, also healing for 2.5x the bite value.
abilities.note: The cone pulls over three seconds while Akeron slows himself. Bites require targets to collide with him; aim allied damage at their changing position.

abilities.ability_text:
Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy.
Upon landing it explodes, dealing 85/125/165/205/245 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
abilities.note: The lobbed orb must land near the target before its stun applies. Use the impact as the signal for follow-up.

abilities.ability_text:
Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s.
The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 20/30/40/50/60 (+18% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. 
After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.
abilities.note: The crystal first pushes enemies away, then pulls them to the center after two seconds. Place delayed damage for the final pull rather than its initial push.

abilities.ability_text:
Aurora creates a ring of frost on the ground around her. Enemies that touch the ring take 70/110/150/190/230 (+50% magical power) magical damage and are Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The ring remains in the world for 2.5s.
abilities.note: Enemies must touch the frost ring to be rooted. Standing inside the ring alone is not an immediate root.

abilities.ability_text:
Aurora freezes an area, applying a 50% Slow to all Enemies for 1.5s. After 1.5s, the ice freezes, Stunning the target for 1s. After the Stun, the Target explodes dealing 200/300/400 (+70% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies.
Enemies damaged by Cryoseism will be Slowed by 50% for 0.5s before exploding, dealing 60/90/120 (+20% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Targets can only be slowed this way once per Cryoseism.
abilities.note: Cryoseism slows first and stuns after 1.5s; its main explosion follows the one-second stun. Coordinate follow-up with the freeze rather than the initial cast.

abilities.ability_text:
Bayle activates the runes on his arm, swinging 3 times to conjure slashes of cursed energy that pierce through all Enemies, dealing 35/50/65/80/95 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage each.
The first two slashes are vertical, while the third is horizontal and Knocks Up and Stuns all Enemies it hits for 0.65s.
If Bayle hits the same Target with all 3 slashes, they take 5/10/15/20/25 (+18% physical power)(+15% magical power) bonus bleed damage every 0.5s for 3s.
abilities.note: Only the third slash knocks up and stuns for 0.65s. The first two slashes are preparation, not a confirmed catch.

abilities.ability_text:
Bayle Slows himself by 60% while he gathers cursed energy, then dashing forward at blinding speed.
If Bayle hits an Enemy Hero, he stops dashing and swings his sword in a massive uppercut, throwing them into the air while pummeling them with a barrage of 8 sword strikes, each dealing 30/40/50 (+24% physical power) (+1/1.3/1.6% Target's Max Health) physical damage.
Finally, Bayle slams the Enemy into the ground, dealing 70/95/120 (+75% physical power) (+3/4/5% Target's Max Health) physical damage in a small area around where they land.
abilities.note: Bayle winds up, dashes into the first hero, then completes the sword sequence before the landing-area damage. Follow the grabbed target's landing.

abilities.ability_text:
Boris generates a defensive Barrier, granting him 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Damage Reduction for 2.5s. 
After the duration, Boris roars, exploding the Barrier and dealing 40/55/70/85/100 (+30% physical power)(+70% magical power) magical damage to all nearby Enemies.
Enemies hit are Feared for 0.5-1s, based on Barrier duration.
Boris may manually detonate the Barrier after 0.5s.
abilities.note: The fear occurs when the barrier detonates. Early detonation is available after 0.5s; fear duration depends on how long the barrier lasted.

abilities.ability_text:
Boris hovers momentarily, before Dashing forward and grabbing the first Enemy Hero he collides with.
Boris then leaps into the air with the grabbed Hero and slams them to the ground.
All Enemies in the landing zone take 250/350/450 (+160% physical power) (+30/45/60% Target's Bonus Health) physical damage and are Slowed by 75% for 1.25s.
abilities.note: Boris must collide with a hero before the leap and landing damage. Allies should follow the landing location, not assume immediate damage at the starting point.

abilities.ability_text:
Leap to an Enemy Hero, forcing them to face Countess and Suppress them for 0.75s.
After the duration, Countess deals 135/215/285 (+5% (+2.5% magical power) of the target's maximum health) magical damage and applying Haemorrhage.
Targets already affected by Haemorrhage take 50% bonus damage and Countess restores health equal to 100% of the damage dealt.
abilities.note: Feast suppresses its selected target for 0.75s before damage. It is a short single-target conversion window.

abilities.ability_text:
Dash forward, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+75% physical power)(+45% magical power) physical damage on contact and Stunning them for 0.25s.
Empowered: Dash an extended distance and pushes Enemy Heroes.
abilities.note: Contact stuns for only 0.25s. The empowered dash also pushes heroes; that brief interruption cannot cover a long allied channel.

abilities.ability_text:
Crunch jabs, dealing 60/90/120/150/180 (+110% physical power)(+75% magical power) physical damage to all nearby Enemies, Slowing them by 50% for 1s.
Empowered: Launch upwards, uppercutting nearby Enemies and Knocking them Up for 0.75s.
abilities.note: The normal jab slows; the knock-up requires the empowered cast. Confirm the empowered attack before treating this as hard control.

abilities.ability_text:
Launch a bouncing bomb, dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Stunning Enemies hit in a small area for 0.9s. 
Stun duration increases up to 1.6s based on distance (3500 units max).
abilities.note: The bouncing bomb must connect. Its stun increases with travel distance, so a close hit supplies the shorter window.

abilities.ability_text:
Summon a bot above the target location that blasts the ground after a short delay, dealing 190/300/410 (+80% magical power) magical damage and Slowing Enemies hit by 50% for 1.5s. 
Enemies caught in the center are Stunned instead.
abilities.note: The strike lands after a short delay. Only its center stuns; the outer area slows instead.

abilities.ability_text: Deploy a circular energy fence for 2.6/2.75/2.9/3.05/3.2s, preventing Enemy Heroes from passing through.
abilities.note: The fence restricts passage for 2.6–3.2s. Enemies can still act within it; area damage benefits from containment rather than a stun.

abilities.ability_text:
Unleash a bazooka blast, dealing 170/280/390 (+115% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies hit and Shredding their Physical Armor by 30% for 4s. 
When used In-Air, the blast launches Drongo in the opposite direction, becoming briefly CC Immune and Pushing Back any Enemies in front of him.
abilities.note: The knockback requires an airborne cast. Direct the blast so it does not remove enemies from allied damage.

abilities.ability_text:
Feng Mao slams his glaive into the ground, dealing 225/300/375 (+40% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area. If an Enemy is below 250/475/600 (+40% physical power) (+480% physical penetration) health, execute them. 
Upon executing an Enemy Hero, Earth Shatter may be recast within 14s at no cost.
abilities.note: Line up the slam on controlled targets. The execute and recast require their actual health thresholds; a catch does not guarantee either.

abilities.ability_text:
Fire an empowered shot forward that deals 30/75/120/165/210 (+105% physical power)(+100% magical power) magical damage.
In Assault Mode, the shot is Lobbed and displaces Enemies away from the centre of the explosion.
abilities.note: The displacement belongs to Assault Mode's lobbed shot. Aim its explosion center to move enemies toward the intended follow-up.

abilities.ability_text:
Throw forward an electrical gate that lasts 2.5s, granting Allied Units that pass through it 40% decaying movement speed for 2.5s. 
If an Enemy passes through, the gate deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Roots them for 1s.
abilities.note: The root triggers when an enemy passes through the gate. Placing it nearby does not guarantee a catch.

abilities.ability_text:
Unleash Gadget's Tesla Dome, dealing 480/780/1080 (+220% magical power) magical damage over 5s to all Enemies caught within. 
Each instance of damage shreds the Target's magical armor by 3.5% for 3s and briefly Slows them by 50%.
Tesla Dome grows 60% larger over its initial lifetime.
abilities.note: Tesla Dome deals its total damage over five seconds. An opening stun covers only part of that time; keep enemies inside for the remaining ticks.

abilities.ability_text:
Damaging an Enemy Hero with an ability empowers Gideon's next basic attack for 3s, allowing him to attach a cosmic tether to his Target. 
Tethered Enemies receive 40/49/58/67/76/85/94/103/112/121/130/139/148/157/166/175/184/193 (+9 per level) (+20% magical power) magical damage over 2.1s, after which they are Rooted for 1s.
Additionally gain 1% Bonus Maximum Mana per 15 Magical Power.
abilities.note: An ability hit must be followed by the empowered basic attack; the tether then waits 2.1s before the one-second root. This is a follow-on catch, not immediate control.

abilities.ability_text:
Unleash a black hole beneath Gideon for 3.5s that slowly drags nearby Enemies towards its center, dealing 520/780/1040 (+250% magical power) magical damage. After channelling for 2.75s, Gideon may act and the Black Hole cannot be cancelled.
For each Enemy Hero hit by Black Hole, Gideon gains (+2% mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s.
abilities.note: Black Hole drags enemies during its 3.5s duration. Gideon must channel for 2.75s before he can act and the hole becomes uncancellable; cover that opening.

abilities.ability_text:
Greystone enters Stasis for 2.5s, restoring 14/16/18% (+2.5% magical power) of his maximum health (increased by up to 2.5x based on missing health) and Slowing nearby Enemies by up to 70%, based on proximity.
After 2.5s, crash down, dealing 250/400/550 (+180% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area.
abilities.note: The landing happens after 2.5s of stasis. Allies need to hold or redirect targets for the delayed landing rather than cast every short control at once.

abilities.ability_text:
Grux raises his clubs in the air before smashing the ground, sending forth a shockwave that Pulls all Enemies in its path towards Grux, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+100% physical power) physical damage and Stunning them for 0.75s.
Range increases based on Channel Duration.
abilities.note: The pull follows the raised-club windup and its range grows while channeling. Aim allied damage where targets arrive beside Grux.

abilities.ability_text:
Grux slams his clubs together, Stunning all nearby Enemy Heroes for 0.75s. 
For the next 8/10/12s, Grux gains 30/60/90% Attack Speed and empowers his attacks against Enemy Heroes to repeatedly steal 3/4/5 (+1.5% magical power) Physical Power on-hit, returning after 4s.
This abilities duration is extended by 0.5s on-hit when Grux attacks Enemy Heroes that are afflicted with Max Bloodlust stacks.
abilities.note: The opening stun lasts 0.75s; the longer attack-speed buff is not a matching control duration.

abilities.ability_text:
Lob a mine that will explode 2.5s after landing, dealing 90/125/160/195/230 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area and Knocking Back any Enemy Heroes (and Howitzer) caught in the blast. Enemy Heroes are additionally Stunned for 0.5s.
Explodes early upon reactivation.
abilities.note: The mine can be reactivated early instead of waiting 2.5s. Its explosion moves heroes and briefly stuns enemies; choose the detonation direction.

abilities.ability_text:
Thrust up into the sky, allowing Howitzer to move freely as he designates target locations to rain down 4 salvos of 8 missiles from above, dealing 544/768/992 (+240% magical power)(+120% physical power) magical damage over 4s.
Missiles utilise laser guidance to home towards Howitzers painted target.
abilities.note: The four-second barrage tracks Howitzer's painted target. Opening control helps aim, but he must keep tracking throughout the barrage.

abilities.ability_text:
Scorch unleashes a cone of flame gaining 20/25/30% Movement Speed and dealing 375/600/825 (+260% magical power) magical damage over 3s.
At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Scorch will belch, instantly dealing 120/180/240 (+60% magical power) magical damage in the area and Knocking Back any Enemy Heroes present.
abilities.note: Inferno deals cone damage over three seconds. The final or reactivated belch knocks enemies away, so avoid ejecting them from a teammate's damage area.

abilities.ability_text:
Ikra unleashes a Water Sphere dealing 85/115/145/175/205 (+50% magical power) magical damage.
The Sphere pierces through Enemy Units but stops on hitting an Enemy Hero, surrounding and Suspending them for 1.1s.
abilities.note: The sphere passes through units but stops on the first enemy hero, suspending that hero for 1.1s. Confirm the hit before following.

abilities.ability_text:
Ikra rises into the sky for 1s and channels the tides before unleashing a surging Waterspout from his Trident that pierces Walls.
The Waterspout deals 320/480/640 (+85% magical power) magical damage and Knocks Up Enemies hit.
When Enemy Targets land from the Knock Up, they are Slowed by 50% for 1.25s.
abilities.note: Genesis channels for one second before its wall-piercing waterspout. Its knock-up occurs on the hit and its slow on landing.

abilities.ability_text:
Based on the chosen Eternal Category, empower Ikras abilities.
Harbingers: Ikra's Fathom deals +(8% magical power) as magical damage. Hitting an Enemy with Fathom reduces the cooldown of Brine by 0.5s.
Primarchs: Popping Hydroclasm now displaces Ikra. Gain 1% Movement Speed per 75 magical power.
Dreadnoughts: Narcosis' Suspension duration is increased by 25% and restores 100% Health of the Hero Damage dealt by it.
Sovereigns: Hydroclasm has 25% reduced Cooldown and Genesis is 25% larger.
Divines: Hydroclasm's Bubbles project an aura that heals Ikra and Allied Heroes for 4/6/8/10/12/6/8/10/12 (+10% magical power) Health every second.
Anomalies: Brine and Hydroclasm deal 3% of the Target’s Maximum Health over 4s and apply 45% Anti Heal for the same duration.
abilities.note: Herald lists different Eternal-category branches. It is not a separate cast or a second control ability, and the chosen category must be known.

abilities.ability_text:
After a brief delay Kallari dashes forward, cutting through all Enemies in her path, dealing 120/250/380 (+65/75/85% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals up to 2.5x damage based on the Target's missing health.
abilities.note: The dash follows a brief delay and damage rises with missing health. A catch helps line up the path; it does not establish an execute threshold.

abilities.ability_text:
After a brief channel, Khaimera slices all Enemies in front of him, Stunning them for 1.25s and dealing 200/400/600 (+200% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage over 6 hits. The final hit Slows by 25% for 1.25s.
Grants 20 Rage stacks for each Enemy Hero or Monster hit.
abilities.note: Cull follows a brief channel, stuns for 1.25s and deals six hits. Stay aligned with targets in front of Khaimera.

abilities.ability_text:
Unleash a torrent of arrows and bullets for 2.5s, dealing 225/330/435 (+460% physical power) physical damage to all nearby Enemies over the duration and reducing their healing by 45% for 2s.
These attacks benefit from lifesteal and can critically strike.
While Purge is active, Kira cannot attack or cast abilities, except Shadow Glide, and is Slowed by 30%.
abilities.note: Purge lasts 2.5s, slows Kira and prevents normal attacks and other abilities except Shadow Glide. Protection and target access must last beyond the first hit.

abilities.ability_text:
Kwang dashes forward, becoming Unselectable and dealing 75/100/125/150/175 (+45% magical power) to all Enemy Units he passes through. 
When the Blade is in the world, if Kwang dashes within 300 units of its radius he will summon it back to his hand with a crash of lightning, dealing the damage to all nearby Enemy Units and Knocking them Up for 0.25s.
abilities.note: The 0.25s knock-up requires the blade to be in the world and the dash to pass within 300 units of it. It is a brief conditional interruption.

abilities.ability_text:
Throw the Heavenly Blade at a target location to deal 90/115/140/165/190 (+40% magical power) magical damage.
Enemies hit by the Blade will be Tethered to it for 1.3s. 
When in the world, the Blade grants vision in a small area around it.
Recalling the Blade early will break the Tether.
abilities.note: The blade tether limits movement for 1.3s but does not establish a stun. Recalling the blade early ends the tether.

abilities.ability_text:
Channel a strike with the Heavenly Blade, dealing 230/340/450 (+80% magical power) magical damage and applying a 45/55/65% Slow for 2s to nearby Enemy Units. 
If the Blade is in the world, Kwang will Teleport to it before striking.
abilities.note: The strike follows its channel. With the blade in the world Kwang teleports to it first; place allied damage at that destination.

abilities.ability_text:
Legion cooks a Grenade with a 2.2s fuse, reducing the time before detonation based on duration held. 
Throw the Grenade causing an explosion that deals 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Launches Legion or Enemies hit. The Grenade automatically explodes after 0.2s if it is near an Enemy.
When cooked for the full duration, it will explode in Legion's hand.
If Legion is Stunned, Killed or cancels the ability whilst cooking the Grenade, it drops to the floor.
abilities.note: Cooking changes grenade timing. It detonates near an enemy after 0.2s and launches targets, so aim both the detonation and the resulting displacement.

abilities.ability_text:
Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% physical power) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies. 
The Standard rallies nearby Allies for 8s if they remain within 1500 units. 
Allies gain 8% Movement Speed and heal for 5/8/11/14/17 (+100% physical penetration) (+10% magical power) Health every Second.
Additionally, Enemy Wards are Revealed.
Legion gains Infinite Ammo.
abilities.note: The call-in knocks nearby enemies back. Preserve the direction that keeps the allied damage hero safe; the standard's later aura is a separate ongoing effect.

abilities.ability_text:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/145/190/235/280 (+60% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s. 
Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.
The hitbox width is 270u. This ability can be Blink-proxied during the cast.
abilities.note: The seismic wave erupts after 0.5s. The normal stun lasts one second; the longer Innovation version requires that condition.

abilities.ability_text:
Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability.
When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s.
Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s, based on the distance it travels.
abilities.note: The gemstone is slow-moving and can be detonated early. Close detonation supplies the shorter stun; travel distance increases it.

abilities.ability_text:
Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels.
When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 70/110/150 (+35% magical power) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it.
At the gemstone's max range, it explodes, dealing 100/160/220 (+50% magical power) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 0.25-1.4s, based on charge time.
abilities.note: Charge changes travel range and stun duration. The rolling stone pushes enemies along its path before the final explosion; follow their destination.

abilities.ability_text:
Channel for up to 3s, Slowing yourself by 25% and wind up your vines, increasing their range over 1s. After 3s the ability will be cancelled and go on a 50% cooldown.
Confirm to unleash the vines that will collide with the first enemy target hit dealing 80/125/170/215/260 (+85% magical power) magical damage, Pulling them towards Mourn and Slowing them by 90% for 0.75s.
abilities.note: The vines need a windup and stop on the first enemy target. The pull and severe slow create the opportunity after the hook connects.

abilities.ability_text:
Mourn channels energy into his fist for up to 2.1s, expanding up to 800u over 1.5s. While channeling, Mourn gains 20% Damage Reduction and Slows himself by 30%.
At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Enemies within take 80/110/140/170/200 (+45% magical power) magical damage and are Mesmerized for 0.45-1.2s (based on 0-1.5s channel duration).
abilities.note: Channel time changes reach and mesmerize duration. Mourn slows himself during preparation; coordinate the release before following.

abilities.ability_text:
Discharge a Terrain piercing shotgun blast, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 (+100/120/140/160/180% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies hit, decreasing by up to 50% based on distance and Shredding their physical armor by 15% for 4s.
The blast Pushes Enemies Back, its force increasing at close range.
abilities.note: The shotgun pushes harder at close range. Use its direction to protect the damage hero or align a follow-up, not automatically knock targets out of it.

abilities.ability_text:
Place a trap that arms after a short delay, dealing 40/80/120/160/200 (+100% physical power)(+120% magical power) magical damage to any Enemy Hero that steps on it and Rooting them for 1.25s. 
Traps last for 40/45/50/55/60s and up to 3/3/4/4/5 may be placed at one time.
Max Charges: 2.
abilities.note: A trap must arm and then be stepped on. Its 40–60s lifetime is not the 1.25s root duration.

abilities.ability_text:
Murdock kneels, preparing an energized sniper shot with unlimited range that can travel through anything.
While targeting, using the Alternate Ability input will zoom the scope inwards.
Upon firing, it deals 250/400/550 (+115% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in its path, ignoring any physical armor.
abilities.note: The shot has unlimited range and pierces terrain, but Murdock must aim the line. A catch creates a shot opportunity, not guaranteed full-map damage.

abilities.ability_text:
Charge a piercing bolt of energy for up to 4s that deals 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slows by 35% for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. 
If Muriel charges Serenity for 1.1s it reaches max charge and deals 98/147/196/245/294 (+70% magical power) magical damage and Stuns the target for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s instead.
If Muriel cancels the charge, 50% of the cooldown and 50% of the cost is refunded.
Projectile radius: 85. Projectile speed: 3900 (official patch-note values).
abilities.note: Serenity requires 1.1s of charge to stun; the uncharged bolt only slows. Time the fully charged hit before committing an ally's follow-up.

abilities.ability_text:
Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 35% Damage Reduction and a 280/480/680 (+100% magical power) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location.
On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100/160/220 (+40% magical power) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.
abilities.note: The shield and damage reduction help the selected ally immediately, but the 0.5s knock-up happens only when Muriel arrives. It is not an independent opening catch at any location.

abilities.ability_text: Toss a drumstick that deals 95/140/185/230/275 (+85% magical power)(+130% physical power) magical damage in a tiny area of effect, Knocking Back and Stunning the Enemies hit for 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s.
abilities.note: Thunk must hit and provides 1.1–1.3s of stun. This is the direct catch option before committing the drum channel.

abilities.ability_text:
Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5/7.5/10 (+4% magical power)(+7% physical power) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. 
Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead.
The final hit deals 80/150/220 (+80% magical power)(+120% physical power) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.
abilities.note: The three-second drum channel builds slow stacks before mesmerize and finishes with a 0.5s stun. Do not treat its final knock-up as immediate on cast.

abilities.ability_text:
Neon lobs a projectile. After 0.5s of landing or colliding with an enemy target, it detonates, dealing 85/120/155/190/225 (+60% magical power) Magical Damage and slowing targets by 35% for 1/1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4s.
Overclocked: Targets are Mesmerized as well as Slowed.
abilities.note: Data Burst detonates 0.5s after landing or hitting. Its mesmerize requires Overclocked; the normal version only slows.

abilities.ability_text:
Channel a beam of energy dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+90% magical power) magical damage over 2.5s. Each instance of damage applies a stacking 3% Slow that lasts 0.6s.
Upon reaching 8 stacks the target is Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
abilities.note: Energy Lance must reach eight slow stacks before rooting. Track the beam and let stacks build; its first tick is not a root.

abilities.ability_text:
Rip a boulder from the earth and carry it for up to 5s. Rampage can throw the boulder, dealing 100/135/170/205/240 (+60% physical power)(+80% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Stunning them for 1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4s. Shatters on contact with Enemy Heroes.
Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.
abilities.note: The boulder must be picked up and aimed. Behemoth removes the pickup delay, but the throw still needs to hit an enemy hero.

abilities.ability_text:
Launch a Soul Orb that deploys upon contact with a Hero or the World. Once deployed, the Soul Orb attacks nearby Enemy Targets, pulling them in and dealing 70/100/130/160/190 (+50% magical power) magical damage over 4s. Enemies that take damage from Soul Orb while below 6% (+1% per 30 Essence) health are executed.
Renna is healed for 16/18/20/22/24% of her damage dealt to Targets attached to the Soul Orb. Healing is 8% effective against Minions and Monsters.
The radius is increased by 1% per 10 Essence.
abilities.note: The deployed orb pulls nearby targets while dealing damage over four seconds. Aim allied damage at the orb; this is not a four-second stun.

abilities.ability_text:
Renna shifts upwards and prepares to launch a ball of demonic energy.
Upon re-activating or after 1.5s, Renna will launch the orb that explodes on contact dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+50% magical power) damage and mesmerizing Targets hit for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
Deals an additional 1% of the Target's Current Health as Magical Damage per 30 Essence.
abilities.note: Renna prepares the orb before launching it on reactivation or after 1.5s. The mesmerize begins on contact.

abilities.ability_text:
After a 1.5s channel, Renna teleports to the Target location and summons an infernal singularity above herself for 5s that unleashes projectiles every 0.5s at nearby Targets that deal 60/78/96 (+24% magical power) magical damage.
Lasts 0.5s longer per 50 Essence.
abilities.note: The teleport takes a 1.5s channel before the five-second projectile field begins. Hold the destination and protect the setup rather than assume immediate damage.

abilities.ability_text:
Launch a cursed orb that deals 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and apply 4 stacks of Marked for 6s.
Dealing damage to a Marked Target deals 15/20/25/30/35 (+20% physical power) (+30% magical power) physical damage and consumes a stack.
Upon consuming all stacks, the Target is Rooted for 1s.
abilities.note: Scar's root requires consuming all four Marked stacks with damage. Applying the mark alone does not hold the target.

abilities.ability_text: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.
abilities.note: The chain catches the first enemy hit and pulls it to Riktor. Aim allied follow-up at the arrival location after the hook connects.

abilities.ability_text:
Unleash a torrent of chains from Riktor, dealing 110/200/290 (+45% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Suppressing them for 1.3s. 
After the Supression expires Riktor rips the chains out, repeating the damage.
abilities.note: Skewer suppresses enemies in front of Riktor for 1.3s and repeats its damage afterward. Confirm the facing and catch before following.

abilities.ability_text:
Scarlett strikes forward with her lantern, with its chain Restraining the first Enemy Hero hit for 1.4s, and Slowing nearby Enemies by 65% for 1s.
Scarlett then backflips into the air, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the Restrain, and ignites her Blade before striking down at her target, dealing 180/280/350 (+100% physical power) physical damage. 
Enemies near the Restrained Hero also receive 100% of the strike's damage.
After striking, Scarlett's Blade remains Ablaze for 8/10/12s, granting her +150 Basic Attack Range, 5 Energy Regen, 20/32/44 (+12% physical power) Physical Power, and enhancing certain abilities for the duration.
Range is 960u.
abilities.note: The chain restrains the first enemy hero for 1.4s before Scarlett's landing strike. The later eight-to-twelve-second blade buff is not a control window.

abilities.ability_text:
Serath takes demonic form, dealing 60/90/120 (+50% physical power)(+80% magical power) physical damage to nearby Enemies and setting them ablaze.
For the next 7s, she gains 20/25/30% movement speed, 20/40/60% attack speed, and empowers her basic attack with Infernal Strikes. 
Infernal Strikes sets Enemy Units ablaze on-hit, dealing 14/27/40 (+25% physical power)(+20% magical power) true damage on-hit over 2s.
abilities.note: Heresy starts with nearby damage but mainly enables seven seconds of repeated attacks. Treat Serath as a sustained attacker rather than a dedicated area-ultimate follow-up.

abilities.ability_text: Sevarog dashes forward through the air, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 (+2.5% health) magical damage to all Enemies he passes through and Fearing them for 1s.
abilities.note: The dash fears enemies it passes through for one second. Fear changes their movement; track the target instead of assuming it stays centered.

abilities.ability_text:
Call down a miasma of dark energy, dealing 60/75/90/105/120 (+40% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Slowing them by 30% and Chaining them to the center for 2s.
If a Chained target leaves the zone, they take 75/90/105/120/135 (+60% magical power) magical damage and are Stunned for 1.25s.
abilities.note: The chain and slow apply in the zone; the 1.25s stun requires the target to leave it. Staying inside is not an immediate stun.

abilities.ability_text:
Deliver a heavy blow from Sevarog's hammer, dealing 200/330/460 (+75% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him.
Enemy Heroes struck by the blow are Knocked Back, sending them flying.

abilities.note: Colossal Blow sends heroes flying. Choose the knockback direction before using it beside an allied damage zone.

abilities.ability_text:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s.
