- The first Ally Hero to walk over it gets it. Enemy Heroes cannot pick it up but it will appear greyscale for them at the location.[/p][/quote][p]Red & Blue Buff:[/p][quote][p]- From 20:00 onwards, Red & Blue Buff now drop an ADDITIONAL Buff Pickup at their original spawn location, that lasts in the world for 30s.

- Jungle Adjustments
- Pit Adjustments[/p][/quote][h3][b]Environment Dressing[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The primary goal of this initial dressing pass is to shift the map's focus away from its current visual simplicity and toward capturing the overall [b]feel[/b] and atmosphere of Sanctuary. This pass is intended to establish the right mood and gameplay readability while we continue making core map changes.[/p][p align="start"]A complete visual overhaul and final dressing pass will take place once the gameplay layout has been finalized.[/p][h3][b]Daybreak Full Mechanics Breakdown:[/b][/h3][p]General Gameplay Changes[/p][quote][p]- Recall Time: Decreased from 8s to 7s.

- Seedling Removed

- 1 Additional Gold buff added to duolane.
- 1 Additional Cyan buff added to offlane.
- Homeguard speed boost added to Jump Pads upon player landing, granting then +400 movement speed, decaying over 9s.
- White Camp Respawn Time increased from 120s to 135s.
- Red & Blue Buff Respawn Time increased from 250s to 255s.[/p][/quote][p]Shrines[/p][p align="start"][i]Shrines are a new mini objective, with 2 being present on the map near each side-lane for teams to fight over. Hey Champions!

It feels like only yesterday we were talking about Ikra, and now we’re here with another update already! We’ve got an awesome new Offlaner, four new Eternals, some incredible new skins, and Brawl Mode is making a comeback! Let’s take a look.

New Hero: Scarlett

In a world where ancient magic intertwines with feudal tradition, a champion of light walks a dark, perilous path. Raised in the ways of combat by her grandmother, Scarlett grew to become a sworn servant of the people, a champion of justice whose kindness is matched only by her mastery of the blade.

For years, her path was clear: defend the helpless and serve as a beacon of hope for those in need. But when a dark, tragic fate struck her beloved, cursing him with a beastly burden, her life was irrevocably altered.

Refusing to let the darkness claim the one she loves, Scarlett now travels the land seeking a cure for his dark curse. Guided by her inquisitive nature and an unyielding knowledge of the wilds, she walks a perilous road between light and shadow. Armed with a blazing spirit, her precise rapier, and a chain lantern to light the way, Scarlett stands ready to illuminate the battlefield and destroy anyone who threatens the innocent.

Scarlett restores 35/45/55 Energy (Levels 1/7/13) if this hits an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader.

Ablaze: While Swan Song is Active, Empowered Cindara’s Bonus Damage is increased by 1.5x.

Each time Scarlett hits an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader with First Intent, she refreshes her Shield’s duration and increases its size by 60%, and restores 50 Energy.

Scarlett then stabs forward 3 times (610u range), with each dealing 21/31/41/51/61 (+24%/28.5%/33%/37.5%/42% Total Physical Power) Physical Damage to all Enemies in the area. The final stab deals up to 100% bonus damage based on the Target’s Missing Health.

Stabs benefit from Lifesteal and can Critically Strike at 60% effectiveness.

Ablaze: While Swan Song is active, the number of stabs is increased to 4, dealing +15% more damage overall.

Scarlett then backflips into the air, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the Restrain, and ignites her blade before striking down at the target, dealing 180/280/380 (+100% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage.

Enemies within a 600u radius of the Restrained Target take 100% of the strike’s damage.

Afterwards, Scarlett’s Blade is Ablaze for the next 8/10/12s, granting her +150 Basic Attack Range, +5 Energy Regen, and +20/32/44 (+12% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Power for the duration. Additionally, Empowered Cindara and Minueta are empowered to deal more damage during this time.

Brawl Mode

Brawl returns! Shiny, new, and very much improved thanks to your feedback! We’ve made some changes to the ruleset, buffs and the map itself.

For those of you that are new to Brawl, it is a fast-paced, 5v5 gamemode where each team has a ticket score that gets reduced each time a Hero dies, Minions die, or when Minions are pushed into the enemy team’s portal. Be the first team to get the Enemy’s Ticket Score to zero to win!

For its return, not only has the Brawl map received some changes to its layout and visuals, but various mechanics have also been switched up that aim to make the mode more fun and resolve some of the pain points raised from its previous iteration.

The full details can be found below in the Brawl Mechanics Breakdown section, but the major points to note are:

- Win Condition: When a Team reaches 50 Tickets, Minion Deaths no longer reduce the Score. Only Hero Kills and Minions entering a Portal can reduce Tickets below 50.
- Orb Prime: Orb Prime no longer spawns in the middle of the map at 10-minutes.
- Lane Fangteeth: No longer appear each time a team has 5 Hero Deaths.
- Giant and Jump Height Buff: The Brown and Pink Golems have been removed and replaced by Cyan Buffs, with New Buffs now being present in the middle of the Map!
- New Buffs: Instead of Orb Prime and Lane Fangtooth, there are now 2 Buffs that appear on either side of the map, spawning every 2-minutes. The Buffs are a range of new Giant Golems that provide powerful effects to the killer's team by collecting a Buff Orb, such as super speed, increased size, Double-Ultimate, and more!
- Primal Fangtooth: Will now also appear at one of these New Buff Spawn Locations, every 2nd spawn. The Team that kills the Primal Fangtooth will now have it spawn on their side of the map, with it charging down the Lane towards the Enemies Portal, scoring a large amount of Tickets if it makes it into the Enemies Portal!
- Multiple Heroes On The Same Team: Heroes are once again limited to 1-per team, meaning you can no longer play 5 of the same Hero on the same team. However, we will enable multi-hero selection for special dates and events, so keep an eye on our socials!

Known Issue: Replays do not currently work for Brawl Mode.

Brawl Mechanics Breakdown

Win condition

- The game ends when a team's tickets reach Zero.
- When a team has only 50 tickets remaining, minion kills no longer reduce tickets.
- Only Hero kills and Portal kills reduce tickets at sub 50 Tickets.

Removed Buffs

- Orb Prime has been removed from Brawl.
- Lane Fangteeth no longer spawn based on Player Kills.
- Purple and Orange Buffs have been removed and reworked into a new Random Buff Giant.

Ticket System

- Killing an Enemy Minion -1 Ticket from Enemy Team.
- Pushing an Allied Minion into the Portal -1 Ticket from Enemy Team.
- Killing an Enemy Lane Fangtooth -1 Ticket from Enemy Team.
- Pushing an Allied Lane Fangtooth into the Portal -25 Tickets from Enemy Team.
- Killing an Enemy Hero -8 Tickets from Enemy Team.

New Buffs

- Each team has access to two Cyan buffs on their side of the map.
- In the center of the map there are new contestable buffs.
- One side has a Random Giant Buff spawns every 2-minutes.
- The other side starts with a Random Giant Buff then a Primal Fangtooth spawns alternating every 2-minutes (every other spawn).

Primal Fangtooth Buff

- Killing it spawns a Lane Fangtooth for the team that secured the kill. It does not provide the Primal Buff in Brawl.
- Health: 3500 (+600 per Level).
- Physical Armor: 20 (+7 per Level).
- Magical Armor: 10 (+8 per Level).
- Damage: 25 (+1 per Level).

Lane Fangtooth Buff

- Health 5200 (+100 per Level).
- Physical Armor 60 (+1 per Level).
- Magical Armor 30 (+1 per Level).
- Damage 40 (+10 per Level) .
- Flame Breath deals 2.5x damage to Minions .

Random Giant Buffs

Random Giant Buffs can spawn a coloured Giant, killing the Giant will cause it to drop a unique Buff Orb of their color at the center of the camp for 30 seconds for the team that secured the kill. Picking up the Buff Orb will grant the player the following buff based on the color.

New Eternals

Four new Eternals are joining the fray in this update! We always envisioned this system to be expandable, and seeing such a great community response to the first release, we wanted to bring some more in to keep build diversity and customisation fresh.

New Eternals Breakdown:

Major Blessing:

- Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 8 (+1 per level) True Damage and apply on-hit effects at 100% Effectiveness (8s CD per Hero).

Minor Blessings (1):

- Forage: Gain 4 additional Gold and 4 additional XP per Minion or Monster kill.
- Dryad's Boon: Basic Attacks decrease basic ability cooldowns by 0.2s on-hit
- Natural Resistance: Cleanse all crowd control and gain 400 Tenacity when below 25% Maximum Health. (Cleanse: 20s CD)

Minor Blessings (2):

- Wind-Rider: Gain 20% Total Attack Speed for 4s after using a Dash, Leap, Teleport or upon leaving Stealth.
- Barkskin: Deal 3 (+1 per Level) Physical Damage to Enemy Heroes that Basic Attack you. This Damage triggers On-Hit Effects at 50% effectiveness. (1s CD)
- Taproot: Basic Attacks restore 1 (+8% Bonus Physical Power) Health On-Hit.

Major Blessing:

- Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. You gain 75% of the Armors Shredded.

Minor Blessings (1):

- Frequency: Gain 2% Total Attack Speed and 2 Ability Haste per Rust Stack currently applied.
- Patina: Gain a 30 (+15 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 12s. Gain 4% Movement Speed whilst the shield holds.
- Dampening: Incoming damage from enemies farther than 1100 units away is reduced by 12%.

Minor Blessings (2):

- Peal: Gain 25 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your ultimate, attacks and abilities apply maximum stacks of Rust for 4s.
- Fracture: Deal 4% (+0.3% per level) more Damage against targets with maximum stacks of Rust.
- Resonant Repair: Whenever you are Immobilized, you restore 3% of your Maximum Health over 4s.

Major Blessing:

- Decrease your size by 10%. Upon casting an ability, nearby enemy Heroes within a 600u radius are debuffed, causing them to deal 4% decreased damage for 3.5s, stacking up to 3 times.

Minor Blessings (1):

- Bioluminescence: Enemies you damage take 3% bonus Damage and are Revealed for 4s.
- Harmonic Currents: Casting an ability restores 2.5% of your Missing Health and Missing Mana.
- Diffusion: Increases the radius of Pilow's Debuff Pulse by 50% and the duration by 1.5s.

Minor Blessings (2):

- Neurotoxin: Pilow additionally increases damage enemies take by 2% per stack.
- Convection: Gain 4 Physical Armor and 4 Magical Armor for every active stack of Pilow on nearby enemy Heroes.
- Lil Sucker: Basic Attacks steal 2% of the target's Movement Speed for 3s, stacking up to 3 times.

Major Blessing:

- Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. Your Max Health is permanently reduced by 5% (+4% Melee/+6% Ranged per Fearless). Gain 5% (+5% per Fearless) increased Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed. Fearless is reset upon death.

Minor Blessings (1):

- Demonic Bargain: Gain 350 additional Gold at levels 1/7/13.
- Risen: When at 3 or more Fearless stacks gain 12% Omnivamp.
- Hellfire Strikes: Basic Attacks deal 3 (+1.5 per level) True Damage On-Hit.

Minor Blessings (2):

- Broken Wings: Your Movement Speed cannot be altered by item or abilities.
- Rite: Abilities cost an additional 5 (+2.5 per Level) Health to cast but you permanently gain 15 (+1 per Level) Ability Haste.
- Psychosis: Deal 3.5% (+0.4% per Level) more Damage to the closest Enemy Hero but 10% less Damage to any other Enemy Hero.

Quality Of Life Improvements

New Critical Health SFX Cue:

- There is a new sound effect when you fall to Critical Health (-25%), that should be more distinct and less panic inducing.

New Practice Mode Cheat Capsules:

Practice Mode has had the following adjustments and additions:

- Haste Capsule now refreshes all Cooldowns when activated.
- There is a new Capsule to Evolve your Crest a stage per hit.
- There is a new Capsule to fully stack stacking Items and/or add some stacks to infinite stacking Items.

Camp Despawning:

- Once the Camp Leader of a Normal Jungle Camp is killed (2/3/4/5 Camp), the remaining Monsters will now despawn after 10s of not being in combat.

Fountain Diving:

- Enemy Fountains no longer 1-shot you upon entering their Zone.
- Upon standing in the Enemy Fountain’s Zone, you now receive ramping true damage instead.
- There is a new Camera Lens Effect & SFX to signify when you enter the Enemy Team’s Fountain.

Client Prediction Adjustments & Blink Rubberbanding:

- Certain abilities (such as Boris Ultimate, Ranged Basic Attacks, Melee Basic Attacks, Bayle Ultimate, and Crunch Empowered Right Crunch will no longer yoink you back or hit you if you manage to get a small distance away from the original location, such as by blinking out of their path.

Enhanced Airborne Hero Shadows:

- Ally and Enemy Heroes now cast a shadowy decal beneath their location on the ground when they are in the air.
- This will make it easier to tell where Flying Heroes such as Howitzer and Wukong precisely are when they are above you, as you will be able to see their shadow directly below them on the ground.

Respawned Inhibitor Clarity:

- Respawned Inhibitors now show a purple material around them to signify they are disabled and do not attack, adding more clarity.

Buff Dropping (Red/Blue/Mini):

Mini Prime:

- Mini Prime now drops its buff on the floor slightly in front of it when it dies, rather than being granted to the killer. The Buffs last for 30s on the floor.
- The first Ally Hero to walk over it gets it. Enemy Heroes cannot pick it up but it will appear greyscale for them at the location.

Red & Blue Buff:

- From 20:00 onwards, Red & Blue Buff now drop an ADDITIONAL Buff Pickup at their original spawn location, that lasts in the world for 30s.
- The first Ally Hero to walk over it gets it. Enemy Heroes cannot pick it up but it will appear greyscale for them at the location.
- Red & Blue Buff are now a slightly different Color when Buff Dropping is active (at 20:00).
- In other words, Junglers can now kill their Buffs late-game, and let an Ally pick up an additional copy of that buff.

Tower Platings Expanded:

- Tier 1 Outer Tower Platings no longer disappear at 13 minutes and are now present for the entire match.
- Tier 2 Inner Towers now also have Tower Platings for the entire match.

Ground Targeting Improvements:

- Ground targeting abilities now aim directly from the Camera reticle, rather than from the Hero’s model. This will reduce the amount of times an ability clips against a wall unintentionally.
- Ground targeting abilities now place at the centre of your reticle, rather than being slightly offset to the left.

Aim Assist Tuning:

- Aim Assist for Controllers has been adjusted to be slightly less sticky, while improving other areas of it that should make the gameplay experience smoother for Controller Users.

Item Effect Stat Tracking:

- A variety of Items now track various stats (such as how much damage they have dealt in a game, among other stats). To see them, hover over yours (or another Player’s) Items on the scoreboard.

Recalls - Damage Over Time (DoT):

- Damage Over Time (DoT) Damage Effects no longer interrupt Recalls.

Custom Games - Additional Modes:

The following modes have been added to Custom Games, and are available to play at any time:

- Brawl
- LABS: Daybreak

Daybreak v7

We're approaching the final stages of development, and this patch introduces a significant number of gameplay and map updates, alongside the first environmental dressing pass using existing assets.

Please note: This is not the final dressing pass - far from it. Everything included in this update is completely placeholder work intended to improve the map for the upcoming tournament while larger-scale visual improvements are still in progress.

What's Changing

- Duo Lane Adjustments
- Mid Lane Adjustments
- Jungle Adjustments
- Pit Adjustments

Environment Dressing

The primary goal of this initial dressing pass is to shift the map's focus away from its current visual simplicity and toward capturing the overall feel and atmosphere of Sanctuary. This pass is intended to establish the right mood and gameplay readability while we continue making core map changes.

A complete visual overhaul and final dressing pass will take place once the gameplay layout has been finalized.

Daybreak Full Mechanics Breakdown:

General Gameplay Changes

- Recall Time: Decreased from 8s to 7s.
- Death Timers increase more aggressively at 30 minutes, instead of 25 minutes.
- Teleporters unlock at the start of the game instead of 480s.
- Teleporter Early cooldown reduced to 120s from 180s.
- Teleporter Late cooldown now triggers at 20:00.
- Teleporter Late cooldown reduced to 90s from 120s.
- WorldShift Removed.
- Shaper Removed.
- Seedling Removed
- Movement speed is reduced by 15 compared to Sanctuary.
- 1 Additional Gold buff added to duolane.
- 1 Additional Cyan buff added to offlane.
- Homeguard speed boost added to Jump Pads upon player landing, granting then +400 movement speed, decaying over 9s.
- White Camp Respawn Time increased from 120s to 135s.
- Red & Blue Buff Respawn Time increased from 250s to 255s.

Shrines

Shrines are a new mini objective, with 2 being present on the map near each side-lane for teams to fight over. Killing them grants global gold, permanent Ability Haste, and bonus damage to Towers for your team!

Stats:

- Spawn time: 120s
- Respawn time: 240s
- Health/Max Health: 650 → 3,100
- Basic Armor: 0
- Ability Armor: 0
- Shrines grant +2 Ability Haste to the killer permanently.
- Kill Gold: 50 Global Gold
- Grant everyone on the Killing team +8% true damage to Towers (Max Stacks: 2).

Statue States

- White: Not taken
- Red: Taken by enemy
- Blue: Taken by team

Daybreak Invitation Tournament

On Saturday August 15th & Sunday August 16th, a 2-day Daybreak Invitational Tournament is happening. This will feature 8 Teams composed of the Top Players from NA PCC Summer!

This event will showcase the Daybreak Map in a more high-stakes environment, allowing us to gather deeper feedback on all things Daybreak as the best players from the North American Region put it through its paces!

For the Format, it is a Player Draft Event, meaning 8 Captains have been pre-selected from the Top NA PCC Summer Teams, who then draft the rest of their squad from the remaining PCC Player pool.

The Teams are competing for the grand prize of $1,000 and representation within the Daybreak Map when it fully releases, as well as additional Platinum Prizes of 50K & 25K for 2nd and 3rd place!

Finally, a Devs vs VennyVens (Reigning EU PCC Summer Champions) showmatch will be kicking off the event, so be sure to tune in to see if the VennyVens have what it takes to bring down the people’s champ, RGSACE!

- Saturday 16th August - \: Top 4 Double-Elimination Finals Bracket.

For the full balance details, head over to our website!

We’re expecting a little more will be needed until we find that sweet spot though, so keep your feedback coming in![/p][h2]Store News[/h2][h3][b]Iron Guard Riktor \[Epic][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/97fc50aa638a5fb0cf3e363f57c0f99d22f11105.jpg"][/img]

If you would like to support future events please consider picking up any of the Victorious skins, bundles and more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/e608f461e73008a29454f5472bf2ee8ad7f1e751.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]New Victorious Skins coming in 1.14.4[/i][/p][p align="start"]We have introduced a Victorious Bundle Core to further support competitive events, which contains all Victorious Skins and a new Victorious Recall and Jumppad exclusive to the Bundle Core. [b]Bundle Cores do not drop duplicate items.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Lastly it’s been requested for there to be more ways to donate towards Esports, so we are introducing a Luxury Donation Cosmetic. This Epic OHE is intended for those wishing to make a larger donation to PCC, so only consider purchasing this if you are willing to make that type of donation. 100% of the sales from this OHE will go into supporting Competitive events.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/3422c47f85d7ca0af97dab35593e4e3f8e3b0f60.png"][/img][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][h3][b]Overview:[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]For this pass, we are primarily looking at smoothing out the gameplay experience and tidying up some of the balance/gameplay loop fallout that has occurred with the addition of the Eternals and the power they have provided. Specifically, this is being done by rounding out the rough edges for some of the more extreme balance outliers and Eternals that are causing extreme power spikes or offering too much/too little general value, with it hopefully resulting in a more well-rounded balance baseline. Hey Champions,

It’s balance time! Eternals totally shook up the meta since their arrival in 1.14, it’s been awesome to see how you’ve all been building and adapting with them.

This update is a larger balance pass to correct some issues we’ve seen with Eternals. We’re expecting a little more will be needed until we find that sweet spot though, so keep your feedback coming in!

Store News

Iron Guard Riktor \

Deadzone Drongo \

Iron Guard Crunch \

Bundles

The Victorious skins are back for a limited time, with some new additions, to support the PCC Summer Summit. All profits from the skin sales go towards supporting competitive Predecessor events!

Victorious Summer Bundle

- Victorious Fight Night Crunch \
- Victorious Prime Technician Gadget \
- Victorious Redeemer TwinBlast \

Deadzone Drongo Bundle

- Deadzone Drongo \
- Crimson Deadzone Drongo \
- Onyx Deadzone Drongo \
- Azure Deadzone Drongo \
- Madness! \
- Deadzone Drongo \
- Deadzone Drongo \

- Drongo \

Bundle Cores

We are introducing a new type of loot core in this patch called Bundle Cores. These cores will be available for limited time and contain a small collection of content, with no duplicate drops and every drop shares the same drop rate.

Premium Bundle Core - Contains 2 exclusive variants for Iron Guard Riktor and Deadzone Drongo plus a selection of previously available bundle exclusive variants from last year.

Victorious Bundle Core - Contains all victorious skins and a new Recall and Jumppad exclusive to this Bundle Core. Profits from this Core go directly to supporting Predecessor Competitive Events.

ARAM Battlepass XP changes

Players shared feedback that with the introduction of quests too much XP was removed from ARAM as a lot of the quests are harder to complete when playing ARAM. We agreed so we are increasing the amount of Battlepass XP gained from playing ARAM by 60%.

Thank you to everyone that shared feedback on the topic.

PCC Summer Summit

The PCC Summer Summit is here and will be kicking off with a 3-weekend event, starting on the 13th and 14th of June at 10 AM EDT/ 2PM UTC on the Predecessor Twitch channel. We'll also be co-streaming with some of your favourite content creators too!

Teams in EU and NA will be competing for a total prize pool of $14,000 and representation in Predecessor via 2d Cosmetics.

More info on the event here.

We will be running Twitch drops during the event weekends, as well as Platinum giveaways, so tune in to pick up some new content!

New OHE available from Twitch drops.

Victorious Cosmetics

The prize pool and event costs for tournaments like this and other community events come from the profits made from the Victorious content. If you would like to support future events please consider picking up any of the Victorious skins, bundles and more!

New Victorious Skins coming in 1.14.4

We have introduced a Victorious Bundle Core to further support competitive events, which contains all Victorious Skins and a new Victorious Recall and Jumppad exclusive to the Bundle Core. Bundle Cores do not drop duplicate items.

Lastly it’s been requested for there to be more ways to donate towards Esports, so we are introducing a Luxury Donation Cosmetic. This Epic OHE is intended for those wishing to make a larger donation to PCC, so only consider purchasing this if you are willing to make that type of donation. 100% of the sales from this OHE will go into supporting Competitive events.

Balance Changes

Overview:

For this pass, we are primarily looking at smoothing out the gameplay experience and tidying up some of the balance/gameplay loop fallout that has occurred with the addition of the Eternals and the power they have provided. Specifically, this is being done by rounding out the rough edges for some of the more extreme balance outliers and Eternals that are causing extreme power spikes or offering too much/too little general value, with it hopefully resulting in a more well-rounded balance baseline. As we mentioned in the v1.14 update, our plan moving forward is to continue refining the balance ecosystem with the new Eternals in mind, which naturally will take a few more passes to get into a nice and stable spot, but for now this should be a positive step forward.

- Addition of some new Magical Power and Physical Power hybrid scalings to various Hero Abilities, opening up Eternal and Build diversity further.
- Tower Durability & Damage increased.
- Minion Durability increased.
- Hunt’s Slay Damage increased to 600/1200.
- Monster Durability increased slightly to compensate for the Hunt change.
- Various adjustments and reworks to Eternal Blessings to help address problem-cases, or make the lesser-picked options more viable in strength compared to the more popular options.
- Small increases to the base damage of various abilities (primarily Mages and Bruisers) to ensure their damage stays a little more relevant at the Level 3-9 thresholds as Durability spikes can result in the inability to adequately threaten kills at that range.
- General Hero Balance to bring the extreme outliers further into general parity.
- Buffs to some Fighter and Anti-tank Items.
- ARAM Tower Durability/Damage increases.
- And more!

Check out all the balance changes on our website!

As a total believer in the cause, Legion revels in the destruction of his enemies, finding his greatest joy in fighting and dying for the glorious empire that gave him life.[/p][p align="start"]Legion’s newest mission has seen him deployed as a heavy-weapons anchor to far-flung battlefields, tasked with enforcing imperial doctrine by any means necessary. He descends upon the front line not as a mere soldier, but as a siege engine of order, stopping at nothing to ensure total purification and the expansion of the Empire’s reach.[/p][h3][b]Stats[/b][/h3][quote][p]- Health: 660 (+132 per Level)

He also gains bonuses based on the Stat Thresholds he reaches:[/p][quote][p]- 100 Physical Power: Saturation Charge Slow Duration increased by 0.75s.
- 30 Physical Penetration: Orbital Sanction Radius increased by 33%.
- 50 Ability Haste: Frag Order deals additional damage equal to 10% of the Target’s Missing Health.
- 100 Magical Power: Rally Point Health Regeneration is increased by 50%.[/p][/quote][p]K-75 Storm Rifle \[Basic Attack]:[/p][p align="start"][b]Type:[/b] Ranged[/p][p align="start"][b]Range: [/b]1500u[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect:[/b] Legion’s K-75 Storm Rifle fires at a fixed rate of 1 Round every 0.2s, with a 15 Round Mag.[/p][p align="start"]Legion’s Rifle Regenerates Ammo at a rate of 1 per 0.2s after not attacking for 1.25s, and he will automatically Reload if his Mag’ is fully exhausted.[/p][p align="start"]Each shot deals 20 (+17% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage, increased by 1.25% per 1 Physical Penetration Legion possesses.[/p][p]Saturation Charge \[Primary]:[/p][p align="start"][b]CD:[/b] 20/19/18/17/16s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 70/75/80/85/90 Mana[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect:[/b] Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world or upon reactivation. Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% Bonus Physical Power)(+40% Magical Power) Physical Damage and Slows targets hit by 40% for 1s.[/p][p align="start"]Cluster Mine damage is decreased to 25% against the same Target for subsequent Mine hits beyond the first.[/p][p]Rally Point \[Secondary]:[/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]30/28.5/27/25.5/24s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 35 Mana[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect:[/b] Legion becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s and slams his Standard into the ground at his feet, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage and Knocking Back nearby enemies.[/p][p align="start"]The Standard creates a large zone that lasts for 8s. While in the zone, Legion gains Infinite Ammo. Legion and Allied Heroes also gain 8% Movement Speed and 5/8/11/14/17 (+110% Physical Penetration)(+10% Magical Power) Health Regeneration while in the zone.[/p][p align="start"]The Standard also provides Vision and reveals Enemy Wards in its local area.[/p][p]Frag Order \[Alternate]:[/p][p align="start"][b]CD:[/b] 16/15/14/13/12s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 50[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect: [/b]Legion prepares a grenade with a 2.2s fuse, able to hold it to cook the grenade, reducing the time before its detonation.[/p][p align="start"]Upon releasing, Legion lobs the grenade to a target location, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80% Bonus Physical Power)(+40% Magical Power) Physical Damage upon detonation.[/p][p align="start"]The grenade will automatically explode after 0.2s if it detects an Enemy Unit within a 300u radius.[/p][p align="start"]If Legion is caught in the explosion, he will be displaced upwards. If Legion holds the grenade for the full 2.2s, it explodes in his hand. If Legion is Stunned or Killed while cooking the grenade, it will drop to the floor.[/p][p]Orbital Sanction \[Ultimate]:[/p][p align="start"][b]CD:[/b] 140/125/110s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 100[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect:[/b] Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, a beam of energy emanating from the atmosphere will blast the location and follow the nearest target (prioritising Heroes) for 6/7.5/9s. If no targets are within 2000 units of the Beam, it will remain stationary.[/p][p align="start"]Enemy Units caught in the beam take 30/50/70 (+28% Bonus Physical Power)(+10% Magical Power) Physical Damage every 0.25s.[/p][h3][b]Augments[/b][/h3][p]Heavy Caliber:[/p][p align="start"][b]Relevant Ability:[/b] K-75 Storm Rifle \[Basic Attack][/p][p align="start"][b]Type: [/b]Basic Attacks[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect:[/b] Legion’s rate of fire is decreased to 0.75s and his Mag’ Size is reduced from 15 to 6. However, his shots deal 440% damage and have +100 Range.[/p][p]Scorched Earth:[/p][p align="start"][b]Relevant Ability: [/b]General[/p][p align="start"][b]Type:[/b] Zone Control[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect: [/b]Frag Order and Saturation Charge’s Mine create 300u radius Napalm zones upon exploding, and Orbital Sanction creates one at its location every 0.5s. Napalm zones last for 3s and deal 5 (+6% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage every 0.5s to Enemies in the area.[/p][p]Press The Advantage:[/p][p align="start"][b]Relevant Ability:[/b] Rally Point \[Secondary][/p][p align="start"][b]Type:[/b] Attack Speed[/p][p align="start"][b]Effect:[/b] Upon achieving a Takedown, a Standard is spawned at the dead target's location. Rally Point no longer grants Health Regeneration, but increases Legion’s Fire Rate by 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% and grants Allies 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Speed.[/p][p][/p][h2]Store News[/h2][previewyoutube="KKlcTlh5Jx4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Iron Guard Akeron \[Epic][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/489c6c67c821dd9445e933b53fc87c577d7ede5f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Iron Guard Skylar \[Rare][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/b6612c0abc425098e15fa4d5c89542d1cddaf9ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Iron Guard Lt. Belica \[Rare][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/9bdacbb1c236a6a19f3be0b7a3e706f9b7f2ce24.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Lord Commander Legion \[Rare][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/0a48a966dc414a6d6a38fb20e9f77ffcf039a437.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Obsidian Sunforged Serath Variant \[Epic - Opal Store][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/ab6aef2538a12f924277bb6021b62f2be2b87fb6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Opal Store[/h3][p align="start"]- All opal store content is now available for limited time only and will start rotating each patch[/p][p align="start"]- Opal [b]Epic[/b] skin variant price has increased from 850 to 1200.[/p][h3]Iron Guard Mega Bundle[/h3][quote][p]- Iron Guard Akeron \[Skin]
- Iron Guard Lt. Belica \[Skin]
- Iron Guard Skylar \[Skin]
- Arctic Iron Guard Akeron \[Skin Variant]
- Arctic Iron Guard Lt. Belica \[Skin Variant]
- Arctic Iron Guard Skylar \[Skin Variant]
- Purple Iron Guard Jump Pad \[ VFX]
- Purple Iron Guard Recall \[ VFX]
- Arctic Iron Guard Akeron \[Banner]
- Arctic Iron Guard Lt. Belica \[Banner]
- Arctic Iron Guard Skylar \[Banner]
- Arctic Iron Guard Akeron \[Profile Icon]
- Arctic Iron Guard Lt. Belica \[Profile Icon]
- Arctic Iron Guard Skylar \[Profile Icon]
- Akeron \[Hero]
- Lt. Belica \[Hero]
- Skylar \[Hero][/p][/quote][h3]Lord Commander Legion Bundle[/h3][quote][p]- Legion \[Hero]
- Lord Commander Legion \[Skin]
- Cobalt Lord Commander Legion \[Skin Variant]
- Quartz Lord Commander Legion \[Skin Variant]
- Alabaster Lord Commander Legion \[Skin Variant]
- Screen Time \[Overhead Emote]
- Lord Commander Legion \[Banner]
- Lord Commander Legion \[Profile Icon]
- Legion Premium Affinity \[Affinity Pass][/p][/quote][h3]Battlepass Bundle[/h3][quote][p]- Harbingers of Ruin \[Battlepass]
- Legion \[Hero]
- Obsidian Lord Commander Legion \[Skin Variant][/p][/quote][h3]Ion Cores[/h3][p align="start"]We’re also adding a bunch of Eternals Icons and Banners into Ion Cores as temporarily exclusive drops! These cosmetics will be available in the store at a later date and will be available for purchase with Amber.[/p][p][/p][h2]Battlepass[/h2][p align="start"]The Harbingers of Ruin battlepass is here! Filled to the brim with awesome rewards on both the free and paid tracks.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/946de8e1f2d87eeb266504a303c38d419494a9de.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Eternals[/h2][p align="start"]Eternals are powerful deities in the Predecessor universe, capable of granting meta-defining “blessings” to worthy Heroes who choose to follow them.[/p][p align="start"]This is a massive new gameplay system that redefines Hero customisation in the game, enabling you to pick from a huge range of Blessings for any Hero you want. Blessings range from high-risk berserker types, who thrive under near-death situations with extreme lifesteal, to unbreakable tanks who scale Max HP infinitely, and everything in between![/p][p][b]How Eternals Works[/b][/p][p align="start"]Eternals are a new gameplay customization feature, replacing the Minor Augments. Eternals allow Players to select one of twelve Deities during the Draft Phase of a Match, based on their gameplay preferences.[/p][p align="start"]Each Deity offers the Player that selects them a powerful unique Major Blessing which is a Passive Effect that persists throughout a match.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, after choosing an Eternal, Players can choose 2 additional Minor Blessings from 2 sets of 3 Minor Blessings that are unique to that specific Eternal.[/p][p align="start"]Eternal Blessings, like Augments, are active from Match start and, once selected for the first time, will be remembered across matches on a per Hero, per role basis, unless you change them. This means if you pick Eternals for Argus in Midlane, and want to play him again in your next match in the same role, the system will remember. If you take him into Support instead, it will go back to the recommended until you change your Eternals for Argus in Support.[/p][p align="start"]In simpler terms, you now start the match with:[/p][quote][p]- 1 Hero Augment.
- 1 Eternal Major Blessing.
- 2 Eternal Minor Blessings.[/p][/quote][p][b]Unlocking Eternals[/b][/p][p align="start"]All 12 Eternals will be unlocked when a player reaches level 10. Players that have not yet reached Level 10 will automatically be given pre-determined Eternals, and respective Minor Blessings, based on their Hero/Role chosen.[/p][p][b]Types of Eternals[/b][/p][p align="start"]Eternals are thematically grouped based on gameplay archetypes and lore. However, these groupings are not prescriptive for gameplay, so we encourage Players to experiment with the Eternals.[/p][p align="start"]In other words, this means that you do not necessarily need to take a “Carry Eternal” while playing as a Carry in order to find success, and could try a “Fighter” or “Supportive” Eternal instead if they synergize well with your Hero or Build![/p][h3][b]Find out more about Eternals [/b][url="https://www.predecessorgame.com/en-US/news/patch-notes/Patch_notes_1.14"]here[/url][/h3][p][/p][h2]Daybreak V5[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/a149bdd7660a8cda258e6500ebf0fd106429b39b.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve got another substantial update coming to Daybreak, our new WIP map! We’ve been hard at work going through your feedback from the last version to bring a bunch of highly requested additions and changes to improve the flow and overall gameplay experience.[/p][p align="start"]V5 should improve the following core pain points:[/p][quote][p]- Jungle flow should feel better in terms of Navigation and Pathing
- Junglers attempting to gank lanes from a Camp should find the flow a lot more natural.
- The constant pressure and chaos of the River Bugs in the Jungle respawning repeatedly should be reduced and the Jungle Bugs should make Jungle pathing feel more intentional and tactical.
- Moments where a Player hits dead-ends due to unintuitive terrain and feeling trapped as a result should be reduced significantly.
- Shrines grant side-lanes an additional mini-objective to fight over for increased interaction, reducing the frequency of freeze-heavy/overly passive gameplay.
- The map feeling overly large should feel reduced through the combination of layout and aesthetic changes applied.
- Game Speed should feel slightly faster and more engaging, with the additional gold and XP available on the map (and the adjustments to the objectives helping to provide new areas to contest) helping games to wrap up more naturally between the 25-35m mark.
- Various Bugfixes regarding the Terrain and Collisions.[/p][/quote][p align="start"]Overall, by taking our learnings from the feedback offered on v3/v4, and actioning the largest pain points expressed by Players in previous tests, with Daybreak v5 we have hopefully created something that Players enjoy a lot more, both in terms of moment-to-moment gameplay and how it feels to explore and navigate. So be sure to let us know what you think on Discord and Reddit![/p][h3][b]Daybreak V5 - Mechanics Breakdown[/b][/h3][p]Terrain & Layout Changes[/p][quote][p]- General adjustments to the elevation/height around the map to feel less steep.
- Full Rework of both Jungles, including their Terrain and Camp locations.
- Lane entrances Reworked for all 3 lanes, further improving the approaches and Line Of Sight (LOS) issues in previous versions.
- Increased the size of the Bases for both Teams, primarily around the Core area.
- Fangtooth and Orb Prime Pits general Layout and Size Adjustments.
- Midlane reworked with various adjustments to its curvature and landscape.
- Duolane slight rework, primarily targeting improvements around the previously unhealthy Bush locations and the overly punishing gameplay they promoted.
- Offlane slight rework, primarily to make the lane feel a little more interactive and dynamic on the edges of the lane, and less of an Island that made others feel unable to interact with it.
- Distance between Towers and general spacing adjusted.[/p][/quote][h3][b]Objectives[/b][/h3][p]Shrines[/p][quote][p]- Added New Objective: Shrines
- Locations:
- Inner side of Duolane.
- Inner Side of Offlane.
- Initial Spawn Time: 120s.
- Respawn Time: Every 120s.
- Shrine Rewards:
- Grants 25 Gold.
- Grants 50 Global Gold.
- Permanently grants the Killer +2 Ability Haste.
- Grants a Team-wide Buff on Kill:
- Shrine Buff:
- Global Team Buff granting +8% Damage against Towers.
- The Buff is twice as effective if both Shrines are controlled by the same team.
- Buff Duration: 120s.
- Shrine States:
- Grey: Ready to Kill
- Blue: Your Team has killed the Shrine and is gaining the Buff.
- Red: The Enemy Team has killed the Shrine and is gaining the Buff.
- Shrine Stats:
- Health: 900.
- Health Regen: 0.[/p][/quote][p]Jungle River Bugs[/p][quote][p]- Jungle River Buffs Replaced with Jungle Bugs:
- They are always the same type of River Bug and called “Jungle Bugs” to differentiate them:
- Red Jungle = Orange Bug.
- Blue Jungle = Pink Bug.
- Note: For testing simplicity, they currently have the same stats and grant the same Buffs as their River counterparts, but do not Evolve.
- Initial Spawn Time: 210s.
- Respawn Time: 120s (No longer on a fixed 2m spawn cycle like River Bugs).[/p][/quote][p]Gold & Cyan Buff Balance[/p][quote][p]- Gold Buff now grants more Gold, but less XP.
- Cyan Buff now grants more XP, but less Gold.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h3]Plus lots more! Head over to our [url="https://www.predecessorgame.com/en-US/news/patch-notes/Patch_notes_1.14"]website[/url] to see the full list of changes![/h3]

He descends upon the front line not as a mere soldier, but as a siege engine of order, stopping at nothing to ensure total purification and the expansion of the Empire’s reach.

Stats

- Health: 660 (+132 per Level)
- Health Regen: 1.4 (+0.15 per Level)
- Mana: 350 (+46 per level)
- Mana Regen: 1.5 (+0.18 per level)
- Attack Speed: 100 (+0 per Level)
- Physical Armor: 30 (+5.1 per Level)
- Magical Armor: 29 (+1.15 per Level)
- Physical Power: 20 (+2 per Level)
- Movement Speed: 665
- BAT: 0.2

Abilities

Ballistic Calibration \
:

Effect: Trooper converts 1% Bonus Attack Speed into 0.75 Ability Haste. He also gains bonuses based on the Stat Thresholds he reaches:

- 100 Physical Power: Saturation Charge Slow Duration increased by 0.75s.
- 30 Physical Penetration: Orbital Sanction Radius increased by 33%.
- 50 Ability Haste: Frag Order deals additional damage equal to 10% of the Target’s Missing Health.
- 100 Magical Power: Rally Point Health Regeneration is increased by 50%.

K-75 Storm Rifle \:

Type: Ranged

Range: 1500u

Effect: Legion’s K-75 Storm Rifle fires at a fixed rate of 1 Round every 0.2s, with a 15 Round Mag.

Legion’s Rifle Regenerates Ammo at a rate of 1 per 0.2s after not attacking for 1.25s, and he will automatically Reload if his Mag’ is fully exhausted.

Each shot deals 20 (+17% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage, increased by 1.25% per 1 Physical Penetration Legion possesses.

Saturation Charge \
:

CD: 20/19/18/17/16s

Cost: 70/75/80/85/90 Mana

Effect: Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world or upon reactivation. Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% Bonus Physical Power)(+40% Magical Power) Physical Damage and Slows targets hit by 40% for 1s.

Cluster Mine damage is decreased to 25% against the same Target for subsequent Mine hits beyond the first.

Rally Point \:

CD: 30/28.5/27/25.5/24s

Cost: 35 Mana

Effect: Legion becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s and slams his Standard into the ground at his feet, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage and Knocking Back nearby enemies.

The Standard creates a large zone that lasts for 8s. While in the zone, Legion gains Infinite Ammo. Legion and Allied Heroes also gain 8% Movement Speed and 5/8/11/14/17 (+110% Physical Penetration)(+10% Magical Power) Health Regeneration while in the zone.

The Standard also provides Vision and reveals Enemy Wards in its local area.

Frag Order \:

CD: 16/15/14/13/12s

Cost: 50

Effect: Legion prepares a grenade with a 2.2s fuse, able to hold it to cook the grenade, reducing the time before its detonation.

Upon releasing, Legion lobs the grenade to a target location, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 (+60/65/70/75/80% Bonus Physical Power)(+40% Magical Power) Physical Damage upon detonation.

The grenade will automatically explode after 0.2s if it detects an Enemy Unit within a 300u radius.

If Legion is caught in the explosion, he will be displaced upwards. If Legion holds the grenade for the full 2.2s, it explodes in his hand. If Legion is Stunned or Killed while cooking the grenade, it will drop to the floor.

Orbital Sanction \:

CD: 140/125/110s

Cost: 100

Effect: Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, a beam of energy emanating from the atmosphere will blast the location and follow the nearest target (prioritising Heroes) for 6/7.5/9s. If no targets are within 2000 units of the Beam, it will remain stationary.

Enemy Units caught in the beam take 30/50/70 (+28% Bonus Physical Power)(+10% Magical Power) Physical Damage every 0.25s.

Augments

Heavy Caliber:

Relevant Ability: K-75 Storm Rifle \

Type: Basic Attacks

Effect: Legion’s rate of fire is decreased to 0.75s and his Mag’ Size is reduced from 15 to 6. However, his shots deal 440% damage and have +100 Range.

Scorched Earth:

Relevant Ability: General

Type: Zone Control

Effect: Frag Order and Saturation Charge’s Mine create 300u radius Napalm zones upon exploding, and Orbital Sanction creates one at its location every 0.5s. Napalm zones last for 3s and deal 5 (+6% Bonus Physical Power) Physical Damage every 0.5s to Enemies in the area.

Press The Advantage:

Relevant Ability: Rally Point \

Type: Attack Speed

Effect: Upon achieving a Takedown, a Standard is spawned at the dead target's location. Rally Point no longer grants Health Regeneration, but increases Legion’s Fire Rate by 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% and grants Allies 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Speed.

Store News

Iron Guard Akeron \

Iron Guard Skylar \

Iron Guard Lt. Belica \

Lord Commander Legion \

Obsidian Sunforged Serath Variant \

Opal Store

- All opal store content is now available for limited time only and will start rotating each patch

- Opal Epic skin variant price has increased from 850 to 1200.

Iron Guard Mega Bundle

- Iron Guard Akeron \
- Iron Guard Lt. Belica \
- Iron Guard Skylar \
- Arctic Iron Guard Akeron \
- Arctic Iron Guard Lt. Belica \
- Arctic Iron Guard Skylar \
- Purple Iron Guard Jump Pad \
- Purple Iron Guard Recall \
- Arctic Iron Guard Akeron \
- Arctic Iron Guard Lt. Belica \
- Arctic Iron Guard Skylar \
- Arctic Iron Guard Akeron \

- Arctic Iron Guard Lt. Belica \

- Arctic Iron Guard Skylar \

- Akeron \
- Lt. Belica \
- Skylar \

Lord Commander Legion Bundle

- Legion \
- Lord Commander Legion \
- Cobalt Lord Commander Legion \
- Quartz Lord Commander Legion \
- Alabaster Lord Commander Legion \
- Screen Time \
- Lord Commander Legion \
- Lord Commander Legion \

- Legion Premium Affinity \

Battlepass Bundle

- Harbingers of Ruin \
- Legion \
- Obsidian Lord Commander Legion \

Ion Cores

We’re also adding a bunch of Eternals Icons and Banners into Ion Cores as temporarily exclusive drops! These cosmetics will be available in the store at a later date and will be available for purchase with Amber.

Battlepass

The Harbingers of Ruin battlepass is here! Filled to the brim with awesome rewards on both the free and paid tracks.

Eternals

Eternals are powerful deities in the Predecessor universe, capable of granting meta-defining “blessings” to worthy Heroes who choose to follow them.

This is a massive new gameplay system that redefines Hero customisation in the game, enabling you to pick from a huge range of Blessings for any Hero you want. Blessings range from high-risk berserker types, who thrive under near-death situations with extreme lifesteal, to unbreakable tanks who scale Max HP infinitely, and everything in between!

How Eternals Works

Eternals are a new gameplay customization feature, replacing the Minor Augments. Eternals allow Players to select one of twelve Deities during the Draft Phase of a Match, based on their gameplay preferences.

Each Deity offers the Player that selects them a powerful unique Major Blessing which is a Passive Effect that persists throughout a match.

Additionally, after choosing an Eternal, Players can choose 2 additional Minor Blessings from 2 sets of 3 Minor Blessings that are unique to that specific Eternal.

Eternal Blessings, like Augments, are active from Match start and, once selected for the first time, will be remembered across matches on a per Hero, per role basis, unless you change them. This means if you pick Eternals for Argus in Midlane, and want to play him again in your next match in the same role, the system will remember. If you take him into Support instead, it will go back to the recommended until you change your Eternals for Argus in Support.

In simpler terms, you now start the match with:

- 1 Hero Augment.
- 1 Eternal Major Blessing.
- 2 Eternal Minor Blessings.

Unlocking Eternals

All 12 Eternals will be unlocked when a player reaches level 10. Players that have not yet reached Level 10 will automatically be given pre-determined Eternals, and respective Minor Blessings, based on their Hero/Role chosen.

Types of Eternals

Eternals are thematically grouped based on gameplay archetypes and lore. However, these groupings are not prescriptive for gameplay, so we encourage Players to experiment with the Eternals.

In other words, this means that you do not necessarily need to take a “Carry Eternal” while playing as a Carry in order to find success, and could try a “Fighter” or “Supportive” Eternal instead if they synergize well with your Hero or Build!

Find out more about Eternals here

Daybreak V5

We’ve got another substantial update coming to Daybreak, our new WIP map! We’ve been hard at work going through your feedback from the last version to bring a bunch of highly requested additions and changes to improve the flow and overall gameplay experience.

V5 should improve the following core pain points:

- Jungle flow should feel better in terms of Navigation and Pathing
- Junglers attempting to gank lanes from a Camp should find the flow a lot more natural.
- The constant pressure and chaos of the River Bugs in the Jungle respawning repeatedly should be reduced and the Jungle Bugs should make Jungle pathing feel more intentional and tactical.
- Moments where a Player hits dead-ends due to unintuitive terrain and feeling trapped as a result should be reduced significantly.
- Shrines grant side-lanes an additional mini-objective to fight over for increased interaction, reducing the frequency of freeze-heavy/overly passive gameplay.
- The map feeling overly large should feel reduced through the combination of layout and aesthetic changes applied.
- Game Speed should feel slightly faster and more engaging, with the additional gold and XP available on the map (and the adjustments to the objectives helping to provide new areas to contest) helping games to wrap up more naturally between the 25-35m mark.
- Various Bugfixes regarding the Terrain and Collisions.

Overall, by taking our learnings from the feedback offered on v3/v4, and actioning the largest pain points expressed by Players in previous tests, with Daybreak v5 we have hopefully created something that Players enjoy a lot more, both in terms of moment-to-moment gameplay and how it feels to explore and navigate. So be sure to let us know what you think on Discord and Reddit!

Daybreak V5 - Mechanics Breakdown

Terrain & Layout Changes

- General adjustments to the elevation/height around the map to feel less steep.
- Full Rework of both Jungles, including their Terrain and Camp locations.
- Lane entrances Reworked for all 3 lanes, further improving the approaches and Line Of Sight (LOS) issues in previous versions.
- Increased the size of the Bases for both Teams, primarily around the Core area.
- Fangtooth and Orb Prime Pits general Layout and Size Adjustments.
- Midlane reworked with various adjustments to its curvature and landscape.
- Duolane slight rework, primarily targeting improvements around the previously unhealthy Bush locations and the overly punishing gameplay they promoted.
- Offlane slight rework, primarily to make the lane feel a little more interactive and dynamic on the edges of the lane, and less of an Island that made others feel unable to interact with it.
- Distance between Towers and general spacing adjusted.

Objectives

Shrines

- Added New Objective: Shrines
- Locations:
- Inner side of Duolane.
- Inner Side of Offlane.
- Initial Spawn Time: 120s.
- Respawn Time: Every 120s.
- Shrine Rewards:
- Grants 25 Gold.
- Grants 50 Global Gold.
- Permanently grants the Killer +2 Ability Haste.
- Grants a Team-wide Buff on Kill:
- Shrine Buff:
- Global Team Buff granting +8% Damage against Towers.
- The Buff is twice as effective if both Shrines are controlled by the same team.
- Buff Duration: 120s.
- Shrine States:
- Grey: Ready to Kill
- Blue: Your Team has killed the Shrine and is gaining the Buff.
- Red: The Enemy Team has killed the Shrine and is gaining the Buff.
- Shrine Stats:
- Health: 900.
- Health Regen: 0.

Jungle River Bugs

- Jungle River Buffs Replaced with Jungle Bugs:
- They are always the same type of River Bug and called “Jungle Bugs” to differentiate them:
- Red Jungle = Orange Bug.
- Blue Jungle = Pink Bug.
- Note: For testing simplicity, they currently have the same stats and grant the same Buffs as their River counterparts, but do not Evolve.
- Initial Spawn Time: 210s.
- Respawn Time: 120s (No longer on a fixed 2m spawn cycle like River Bugs).

Gold & Cyan Buff Balance

- Gold Buff now grants more Gold, but less XP.
- Cyan Buff now grants more XP, but less Gold.

Plus lots more! Head over to our website to see the full list of changes!

[p]Hello, Champions, and Happy New Year![/p][p align="start"]We haven’t seen you since last year, but luckily we haven’t had to wait long. The year has barely begun, and things are already falling into place for V1.11, arriving next Tuesday, January 13th![/p][p align="start"]And there are some rather exciting things waiting for you in this one![/p][p align="start"]Without further ado, let’s dive into:[/p][list][*][p]New Hero: Maco, a menace and a healer![/p][/*][*][p]New Year, better Nitro![/p][/*][*][p]AFK VP loss mitigation[/p][/*][*][p]Party Boost XP[/p][/*][*][p]Community Voted Fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Forever Hero Pack[/p][/*][*][p]New skins[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]New Hero: Maco, the adorable menace[/h2][p align="start"]Predecessor Heroes can be many things: a special figure to their people, vigilantes who uphold justice, or warriors who have chosen the wrong path… Maco is none of them.[/p][p align="start"]It’s fair to say Maco is the hero of his own story. Like many of his kind - the Critterkin, inhabitants of Velrune’s forests and subterranean burrows - he loves to sleep, snack, and collect shiny things.[/p][p align="start"]As part of his duties, Maco was assigned to guard a shift so the rest of his family could sleep in peace. But his irresistible urge to try on the royal crown - the shiniest of objects - sent everything tumbling: the precious stones were lost, and the fear of a royal telling-off has now launched Maco on a grand quest to find replacement jewels. You can learn more about his story [url="https://www.predecessorgame.com/en-US/universe/stories/macos-magnificent-mishap"]here[/url].[/p][p align="start"]And that’s where we meet him: our new Support Hero, ready to heal you on the battlefield - and perhaps your soul, a little bit too.[/p][h3][b]Stats[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Health: 675 (+113 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Health Regen: 1.5 (+0.2 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Mana: 400 (+38 per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Regen: 2 (+0.12 per level)[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Speed: 120 (+1.4 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Physical Armor: 22 (+4.3 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Magical Armor: 27 (+0.95 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Physical Power: 57 (+3.9 per Level)[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Speed: 665[/p][/*][*][p]BAT: 1.2[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Abilities[/b][/h3][p][b]Mach Speed! \[Passive][/b][/p][p align="start"]As Maco moves, he gains stacks of Movement Speed up to 15% (+0.75% per level).[/p][p align="start"]When Maco reaches 25 stacks, he gains Mach Speed, which grants him Slow Immunity.[/p][p align="start"]After taking Damage from Enemy Heroes or standing still, he retains all buffs for 3s before they are removed.[/p][p]Ta-Da! \[Basic Attack][/p][p align="start"]Ranged basic attack dealing 57 (+55% Physical Power) physical damage.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, Maco gains a stack each time he successfully Basic Attacks an Enemy, up to a max of 4. At max stacks, Maco’s next ability’s Cooldown is reduced by 1s and all stacks are removed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maco Gift! \[Primary][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]7s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 50/75/100/125/150 Health[/p][p align="start"][b]Active:[/b] Maco lobs a gemstone that hurts or heals depending on the Target hit.[/p][p align="start"]If Maco hits an Ally, they are Healed for 50/70/80/110/130 (+35% Magical Power) Health in addition to 1/1.5/2/2.5/3% of their Max Health. Allies also gain 10/12/14/16/18% (+3% Magical Power) Movement Speed for 3s.[/p][p align="start"]If Maco hits an Enemy, they take 75/110/145/180/215 (+50% Magical Power) magical damage.[/p][p align="start"]Maco cannot hit himself with this ability.[/p][p align="start"][b]Passive:[/b] Hitting either Allied or Enemy Heroes with any ability Heals you for 20/30/40/50/60 (+2% Magical Power) (+0.3% Max Health) Health.[/p][p align="start"]Using this ability costs Health instead of Mana.[/p][p]
[b]Maco Fly! \[Secondary][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]16/15.25/14.5/13.75/13s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost: [/b]80/85/90/95/100[/p][p align="start"]Maco leaps high into the air before slamming back down to the ground with his gemstone, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+85% Magical Power) magical damage to Enemies and Slowing them by 25% (+3% Magical Power) for 1.5s.[/p][p align="start"]If Maco hits an Enemy Hero, he gains a 80/135/190/245/300 (+40% Magical Power) (+7.5% Max Health) Health Shield for 4.5s.[/p][p align="start"]After landing, Maco dashes slightly in the direction he is currently moving.[/p][p]
[b]Maco Sparkle! \[Alternate][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD: [/b]13/12.5/12/11.5/11s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost:[/b] 70/75/80/85/90[/p][p align="start"]Maco throws a slow-moving gemstone that explodes at its max range, or when detonated early by reactivating the ability.[/p][p align="start"]When the gemstone explodes, it deals 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% Magical Power) magical damage and Stuns Enemies for 0.5s.[/p][p align="start"]Stun Duration increases up to 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3s based on distance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maco Strike! \[Ultimate][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]CD:[/b] 115/95/75s[/p][p align="start"][b]Cost: [/b]150[/p][p align="start"]Maco charges up his gemstone for up to 1s, increasing the range it travels.[/p][p align="start"]When Maco releases the charged gemstone, it barrels forward along the ground, dealing 80/130/180 (+40% Magical Power) magical damage and Pushing and Stunning all Enemies it hits along with it.[/p][p align="start"]At the gemstone’s max range, it explodes, dealing 120/195/270 (+70% Magical Power) magical damage and Stunning all Enemies hit for 1s.[/p][h3][b]Augments[/b][/h3][quote][p][b]Longshot:
[/b]- Related Ability: Alternate
- Type: Ability Damage
- Effect: Maco Sparkle’s damage scales linearly based on how far it travels from 100% to 200% damage.[/p][/quote][quote][p][b]Shatterbloom
[/b]- Related Ability: Ultimate
- Type: Healing
- Effect: Maco Strike creates a Healing field at the explosion location that Heals 15/25/35 (+4% Magical Power) every 0.25s for 5s.[/p][/quote][quote][p][b]Ferocious Flight[/b]
- Related Ability: Secondary
- Type: Shielding
- Effect: For each Enemy hit by Maco Fly, Maco gains 40/60/80/100/120 (+12.5% Magical Power) (+1.5% Max Health) additional Shielding and the ability’s Cooldown is reduced by 1s. This effect also occurs on non-Heroes but is reduced by 80%.[/p][/quote][h2]Have your say - Results[/h2][p align="start"]When we decided to dedicate V1.11 to small fixes with a big impact, we knew we didn’t just want to rely on our internal view of the game’s most-needed improvements - we wanted to involve you, our community, as well![/p][p align="start"]During a 10-day period in early November, you were able to submit issues in a dedicated Discord channel, where others could upvote or downvote each entry.[/p][p align="start"]We’ve compiled, analysed, and reviewed all the feedback, and assessed what we could squeeze into 1.11, considering the resources available - especially with the holiday season approaching. Additionally, we wanted to ensure that the proposed changes aligned with our goal of prioritizing adjustments with a big impact.[/p][p align="start"]This entire process has given us valuable insights into which Quality of Life changes are important to you. We’ve prepared a list of what we’ll be addressing in V1.11, as well as the things that we are aiming to ship in future releases later in 2026 and beyond.[/p][h3][b]Feedback We’ll Be Acting On in V1.11[/b][/h3][p][b]Adjustment of Tower Hitboxes[/b][/p][p align="start"]We heard the feedback that the hitboxes of towers don’t align properly with their actual shape. We’ll be adjusting this in V1.11 to improve aiming precision and fairness while engaging with the towers.[/p][p]Show Who Killed Fangtooth/Orb Prime[/p][p align="start"]A popular request that’s quick enough to implement - notifications for Fangtooth and Orb Prime will now include the name of the player who dealt the fatal blow. We’ll also let you know if the objective was stolen… just in case that information comes in handy for any revenge plans.[/p][p][b]Ranked Changes[/b][/p][p align="start"]Ranked is another part of the game that’s highly dynamic and frequently evolving, and it received its fair share of requests. We want to let you know that several of your requested changes to Ranked are being implemented in V1.11! You can find the exact breakdown of changes in the Ranked section.[/p][p][b]Play Any Hero in Practice[/b][/p][p align="start"]Starting in V1.11, you will be able to play any Hero in Practice mode, without needing to purchase them first![/p][p align="start"]This change will hopefully allow you to find Hero fitting your playstyle more easily, test them more thoroughly and allow you to make better informed decisions before spending Amber or Platinum on them.[/p][p][b]Social Screen Improvements[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’re adding more at-a-glance information about your Predecessor friends! When you select a friend in the Friends List, you’ll see their level, rank, and VP displayed at the top of the options menu (where you can mute/unmute, remove friend, etc.).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34481624/78722bd7f3105dbf994386ec1579f4ff37106187.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Ultimate Hero Pack: Every Hero, Now and Forever[/b][/p][p align="start"]One of the most commonly requested features, especially for new players is the option to buy all of our Heroes in one go.[/p][p align="start"]We’re delighted to announce that we’re launching our Ultimate Hero Pack on the 21st of January, which instantly grants you access to our entire roster of currently available Heroes, plus every single new Hero we release in the future, at no additional cost.[/p][p align="start"]The bundle will launch with a 33% discount for $19.99 for the first 2 weeks until the 4th of February then returning to $29.99. The discount is only available on Steam, Epic and PSN stores due to platform restrictions.[/p][p align="start"]What’s included:[/p][list][*][p]Instant Access: Every currently playable Hero is unlocked immediately.[/p][/*][*][p]Lifetime Value: All future Heroes are automatically added to your collection at release.[/p][/*][*][p]Amber Refunds: Get an Amber refund for every Hero you already unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]This is a one-time purchase, all Heroes are permanently unlocked on your account. When a new Hero enters the fray, they will be waiting for you in your collection, no grinding required.[/p][p align="start"]Note: Amber refunds are granted for previously unlocked Heroes using their current Amber value.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Priorities For Us To Address In Future Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We received many excellent suggestions for new Quality of Life features, but some of them fall outside the scope of what we could realistically achieve in time for V1.11.[/p][p align="start"]The following is a list of features we’re hoping to bring to the game at a later date - [b][u]they are not included in V1.11.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Stability Improvements[/b][/p][p align="start"]We have some major performance and stability fixes coming to the game (including quite a few for the PlayStation version - watch this space). They still need a bit more work before they’re ready to ship, but you can expect them soon - over the next few weeks.
[/p][p][b]Daily and Weekly Challenges[/b][/p][p align="start"]You’ve asked for challenges to give you goals to work towards, and we get it! In fact, we’ve done a lot of groundwork for this feature already, but it still requires some additional time before we can consider it ready. However, now that we know just how much you’re looking forward to this feature, we’re hopeful it won’t be long before we’re able to introduce it to Predecessor.
[/p][p][b]Different Crosshairs for Different Heroes[/b][/p][p align="start"]Another highly requested feature, particularly for Heroes like Revenant, Murdock, and Bayle. While it’s a great idea, it unfortunately didn’t fit within the scope of this update. Fear not, this request will very much stay on our minds for the future!
[/p][p][b]Post-Match & Replay Build Visibility[/b][/p][p align="start"]Many of you upvoted the suggestions that pertained to the end of the match screen and replays - and one of the most popular ones asked for the ability to view player builds at the end of a match, while watching replays. We fully agree that this would improve the end of a match experience and would help learning experience. We are currently discussing the whole end of match experience because we think we can make several improvements there, and this will likely be part of that future work.
[/p][p][b]Hero Customization Page[/b][/p][p align="start"]A popular suggestion to create a hero customization tab in the main menu, where players could adjust keybinds, cosmetics, and builds. This is an excellent idea, and something we’d love to work on in the future.
[/p][p][b]Limiting Paragon Rank to 100 Players[/b][/p][p align="start"]We heard your feedback on increasing the prestige of the highest rank by strictly limiting it to a small number of players. We like that idea, we believe it makes plenty of sense, however, other Ranked system changes need to happen first before we can introduce this one, so this isn’t something we’ll be addressing in V1.11.
[/p][p][b]Switching Heroes in Practice Mode[/b][/p][p align="start"]You’ve asked for the ability to switch Heroes without leaving practice mode. We sympathize with this, it would be a great QoL feature! This requires some work though before we can introduce it, more work that we could fit in before V1.11.
[/p][p][b]Fog in the Jungle (from Shadows Eve Map)[/b][/p][p align="start"]This small visual effect, serving little more function than being a spooky flourish on the Shadow’s Eve map, has clearly charmed many of you, as it was one of the more popular suggestions. While we won’t be reintroducing it in V1.11, we wanted you to know that we’ve heard your request and will keep it in mind for the future especially in the design for our new map.
[/p][p][b]Ranked Matchmaking Improvements - Coming Soon[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’re still working on a major improvement to the matchmaking system, one that blends VP and our internal MMR much more effectively when creating matches. It isn’t quite ready yet, but we’re hoping to ship it before the current split ends, so watch this space.[/p][h2]
Ranked News[/h2][h3][b]Ranked Mode is Expanding![/b][/h3][p][b]SA[/b][/p][p align="start"]You really showed up, SA players! Ever since we launched Ranked in SA, we’ve been seeing awesome results, so based on the data, we’re happy to announce that SA Ranked will now be available every day![/p][p align="start"]Starting January 13, on weekdays (Monday–Friday), Ranked will be open from 17:00 BRT (20:00 UTC) until 00:00 BRT (03:00 UTC). Weekend windows will remain unchanged.[/p][p][/p][p][b]OCE & ASIA Ranked Test[/b][/p][p align="start"]The time has come - we want to test Ranked viability on OCE and ASIA servers![/p][p align="start"]Please keep in mind that, for now, this is only a test that we plan to run for a few weeks. We may extend it if we see good results and healthy queues, but we may also end it early if Ranked negatively impacts matchmaking in those regions.[/p][p align="start"][b]OCE - [/b]Starting Saturday, January 10, Ranked will be open on OCE from 20:00 AEDT (09:00 UTC) until 00:00 AEDT (13:00 UTC).[/p][p align="start"][b]ASIA - [/b]Starting Saturday, January 10, Ranked will be open on ASIA from 22:00 JST (13:00 UTC) until 02:00 JST (16:00 UTC).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ranked AFK VP Mitigation[/b][/h3][p align="start"]This feature is a popular request from Ranked players.
